{=str_tor_perk_run_and_gun_label}Run and Gun
{=str_tor_perk_run_and_gun_1}While on foot and using a pistol, your accuracy penalty for moving is reduced by 20%.
{=str_tor_perk_run_and_gun_2}Gunpowder infantry troops in your party have their gunpowder skill increased by 30.
{=str_tor_perk_mounted_heritage_label}Mounted Heritage
{=str_tor_perk_mounted_heritage_1}Your accuracy is increased by 20% with gunpowder weapons when mounted.
{=str_tor_perk_mounted_heritage_2}Mounted ranged troops in your party have their riding skill increased by 30.
{=str_tor_perk_firing_drills_label}Firing Drills
{=str_tor_perk_firing_drills_1}Immediately gain +1 Discipline.
{=str_tor_perk_firing_drills_2}Gunpowder troops in your party recieve +5 experience per day.
{=str_tor_perk_ammunition_wagons_label}Ammunition Wagons
{=str_tor_perk_ammunition_wagons_1}+50% starting ammunition for all gunpowder troops (including player).
{=str_tor_perk_ammunition_wagons_2}Increase your party's inventory capacity by 30%.
{=str_tor_perk_close_quarter_label}Close Quarters
{=str_tor_perk_close_quarter_1}You deal 25% increased damage with gunpowder weapons to enemies within 7 meters.
{=str_tor_perk_close_quarter_2}Ranged troops in your party have their One-handed skill increased by 30.
{=str_tor_perk_dead_eye_label}Dead Eye
{=str_tor_perk_dead_eye_1}You deal 30% increased damage with longrifles.
{=str_tor_perk_dead_eye_2}Two-Handed gunpowder troops in your formation have their accuracy increased by 20%.
{=str_tor_perk_bullet_proof_label}Bullet Proof
{=str_tor_perk_bullet_proof_1}You take 15% less damage from handheld ranged weapons.
{=str_tor_perk_bullet_proof_2}Troops in your formation receive 5% less damage from handheld ranged weapons.
{=str_tor_perk_bomb_suit_label}Bomb Suit
{=str_tor_perk_bomb_suit_1}You take 25% less damage from siege artillery and explosions.
{=str_tor_perk_bomb_suit_2}Troops in your formation receive 10% less damage from siege artillery and explosions.
{=str_tor_perk_pack_it_in_label}Pack It In
{=str_tor_perk_pack_it_in_1}When you are using a multi-projectile gunpowder weapon, increase the number of projectiles by 50%.
{=str_tor_perk_pack_it_in_2}Troops in your formation using explosive gunpowder weapons gain +10% bonus damage and the damage is converted to Fire Damage.
{=str_tor_perk_steel_terror_label}Steel Terror
{=str_tor_perk_steel_terror_1}Artillery and explosive weapons in your party deal +10% morale damage in battle.
{=str_tor_perk_steel_terror_2}Artillery crews and engineers in your party become unbreakable due to morale loss.
{=str_tor_perk_piercing_shots_label}Piercing Shots
{=str_tor_perk_piercing_shots_1}Your shots ignore 50% of enemy armor and penetrate shields.
{=str_tor_perk_piercing_shots_2}Gunpowder troops in your party pierce shields.
{=str_tor_perk_novice_spellcaster_label}Novice Spellcaster
{=str_tor_perk_novice_spellcaster_1}Gain access to entry level spells.
{=str_tor_perk_adept_spellcaster_label}Adept Spellcaster
{=str_tor_perk_adept_spellcaster_1}Gain access to adept level spells.
{=str_tor_perk_master_spellcaster_label}Master Spellcaster
{=str_tor_perk_master_spellcaster_1}Gain access to master level spells.
{=str_tor_perk_selfish_1}Your damaging spells do 90% reduced damage to yourself.
{=str_tor_perk_selfish_2}Your self targeted buff spells have 50% more duration.
{=str_tor_perk_well_controlled_label}Well Controlled
{=str_tor_perk_well_controlled_1}Your damaging spells do 30% less damage to troops in your party.
{=str_tor_perk_well_controlled_2}Gain 5% advantage in simulation battles.
{=str_tor_perk_librarian_1}You gain double experience from reading books.
{=str_tor_perk_librarian_2}Learning new spells cost 50% less gold.
{=str_tor_perk_story_teller_1}Every companion in your party gains 1000 experience in a random skill per day.
{=str_tor_perk_story_teller_2}Your party gains a permanent +5 increase to party morale.
{=str_tor_perk_overcaster_1}Your damaging spells do 20% more damage but cost 30% more winds of magic.
{=str_tor_perk_effective_spellcaster_label}Efficient Spellcaster
{=str_tor_perk_effective_spellcaster_1}Your damaging spells do 20% less damage, but cost 30% less winds of magic.
{=str_tor_perk_improvision_1}Your Winds of Magic is set to 25 if you have less than that at the beginning of the battle.
{=str_tor_perk_improvision_2}+10% Persuasion chance during speech checks.
{=str_tor_perk_catalyst_1}For every magical item in your equipment slots you gain +5 extra Winds of magic at the start of battle.
{=str_tor_perk_catalyst_2}You gain +20% Winds of Magic regeneration while waiting in a town.
{=str_tor_perk_dampener_1}Damage dealt by your damaging spells is reduced by 15%, but troops in your formation take 30% less damage from spells.
{=str_tor_perk_dampener_2}You gain 5% ward save.
{=str_tor_perk_arcane_link_label}Arcane Link
{=str_tor_perk_arcane_link_1}Any buffs you cast on a friendly unit will now also apply to you even if you are not in range.
{=str_tor_perk_arcane_link_2}As formation Captain, all troops in your formation deal additonal 10% magic damage.
{=str_tor_perk_exchange_1}All physical damage done by your weapons is doubled and dealt again as magical damage.
{=str_tor_perk_novice_prayer_label}Novice Prayers
{=str_tor_perk_novice_prayer_1}Gain access to all novice level battle prayers.
{=str_tor_perk_adept_prayer_label}Adept Prayers
{=str_tor_perk_adept_prayer_1}Gain access to all adept level battle prayers.
{=str_tor_perk_grand_prayer_label}Grand Prayers
{=str_tor_perk_grand_prayer_1}Gain access to all grand level battle prayers.
{=str_tor_perk_devotee_1}You gain +3 hitpoints for every point in Discipline.
{=str_tor_perk_devotee_2}Praying at a shrine grants 50% increased devotion towards your chosen religion.
{=str_tor_perk_divine_mission_label}Divine Mission
{=str_tor_perk_divine_mission_1}You gain 1 focus point in Medicine.
{=str_tor_perk_divine_mission_2}5% increased militia growth in settlements owned by your clan.
{=str_tor_perk_imperturbable_1}Gain 500 Faith skill experience every day while waiting at a settlement.
{=str_tor_perk_imperturbable_2}Religious units in your party gain 10% physical resistance.
{=str_tor_perk_superstitious_1}Cursed regions on the world map have 20% reduced damaging effect on your party.
{=str_tor_perk_superstitious_2}Religious units in your party gain 10% bonus physical damage.
{=str_tor_perk_offering_1}Obtain the ability to donate items at shrines as sacrifical offering to gain Faith.
{=str_tor_perk_blessed_1}Your clan gains 3 Influence every day for every clan party with an active blessing.
{=str_tor_perk_blessed_2}While your party has an active blessing, religious units in your party gain 10xp every day.
{=str_tor_perk_foresight_1}Gain a free attribute point.
{=str_tor_perk_foresight_2}Increase your party's sight range on the campaign map by 10%.
{=str_tor_perk_revival_1}After all medicine/healing related skills fail, gain a second 50% chance for characters and units that would be killed to be wounded instead.
{=str_tor_perk_spirit_1}Whenever a tier 6 or higher unit dies, distribute their experience among the rest of the troops in the party.
{=str_tor_perk_miracle_1}Your faith is so strong that it is able to manifest miraculous events from time to time.

{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_issue_brief}As a matter of fact, I have a lead on a potential cultist. A grave accusation that needs investigating.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_issue_accept_player}What needs to be done?

{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_issue_explanation}I need you to travel to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}. Investigate the local populace and root out any cultists. On successful completion, the order will pay you {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_accept_player}Consider it done.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_issue_title}A cultist in our midst
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_description}Travel to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} and root out any cultist who may be hiding there.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_quest_title}A cultist in our midst
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_offer_dialog}Excellent. Do not underestimate the ruinous powers, unwavering vigilance is required on your quest!
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_discuss_dialog}It was good doing business with you.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_prepare_to_die}Prepare to die!
{=str_khorne_cultist_mission}This vessel is mine. Don't interfere with my plans!
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_out_of_time_log}You failed to complete the investigation in time. Any potential cultists are surely in the wind now.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_village_raided_title}Village Raided
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_village_raided_info}The village has been raided. Any cultists have likely fled or gone into hiding. Return when the village has been repopulated.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_log_updated_success}You were successful in uncovering the cultists.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_log_updated_fail}The cultists have fled before you could deal with them.
{=str_tor_quest_hunt_cultist_started}You were tasked to travel to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} and root out any cultist who may be hiding there.

{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_issue_brief}As a matter of fact, I have a lead on potential cultist activity. A village is struck by a terrible, unnatural plague. A grave matter that needs investigating.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_issue_accept_player}What needs to be done?

{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_issue_explanation}I need you to travel to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}. Investigate the situation and find root cause of the plague. On successful completion, the order will pay you {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_accept_player}Consider it done.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_title}The plague ridden village
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_description}Travel to target settlement and find the cause of the unnatural epidemic that plagues the village.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_quest_title}The plague ridden village

{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_discuss_dialog}It was good doing business with you.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_out_of_time_log}You failed to complete the investigation in time.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_raided_info}The village is raided, no chance to find any cultists now. Come back when the village is repopulated.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_log_updated_success}You were successful in lifting the plague.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_log_updated_fail}You abandoned the mission.
{=str_tor_quest_plagued_village_started}You were tasked to travel to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} and investigate the epidemic that plagues it.

{=str_tor_priest_hub_intro_cult_of_ulric}In the name of Ulric, how can I help you?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_reintro_cult_of_ulric}What else?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_blessings_p_cult_of_ulric}Can you show me how to bless weapons in the name of Ulric?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_quit_p_cult_of_ulric}Have a great day Mr Wolf man - Sir.
{=str_tor_priest_blessings_1_cult_of_ulric}Sure, against a small donation I will show you scribes that allow a priest to bless your weapons.
{=str_tor_priest_blessings_decline_cult_of_ulric}You should talk to an Alchemist first. There is much more to learn before I can show you how you can bless your equipment.
{=str_tor_priest_start_accept_cult_of_sigmar}Welcome, friends of the Empire.
{=str_tor_priest_start_decline_cult_of_sigmar}You need a follower of Sigmar if you wish to speak to me, stranger.
{=str_tor_priest_start_decline_hard_cult_of_sigmar}Begone from my sight, at once!
{=str_tor_priest_hub_intro_cult_of_sigmar}In the name of Sigmar, how can I help you?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_reintro_cult_of_sigmar}Was there something else?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_blessings_p_cult_of_sigmar}Can you show me how to bless weapons in the name of Sigmar?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_party_blessing_p_cult_of_sigmar}Can my party receive Sigmar's blessing?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_quit_p_cult_of_sigmar}I must leave.
{=str_tor_priest_blessingshop_1_cult_of_sigmar}Sure, against a small donation I will show you scribes that allow a priest to bless your weapons.
{=str_tor_priest_blessingshop_decline_cult_of_sigmar}You should talk to an Alchemist first. There is much more to learn before I can show you how you can bless your equipment.
{=str_tor_priest_blessing_party_1_cult_of_sigmar}In the name of Sigmar, I bless you.
{=str_tor_priest_blessings_decline_cult_of_sigmar}You have been blessed recently, there is no need of giving you the blessing of a god.
{=str_tor_priest_start_accept_cult_of_shallya}Welcome, friend of Shallya.
{=str_tor_priest_start_decline_cult_of_shallya}You need a follower of Shallya in your party if you wish to speak to me, stranger.
{=str_tor_priest_start_decline_hard_cult_of_shallya}You are not welcome here, leave at once!
{=str_tor_priest_hub_intro_cult_of_shallya}Shallya welcomes you with open arms.
{=str_tor_priest_hub_reintro_cult_of_shallya}Was there something else you needed, friend?
{=str_tor_priest_hub_blessingshop_p_cult_of_shallya}Tell me more about blessing items in the name of Shallya.
{=str_tor_priest_hub_party_blessing_p_cult_of_shallya}We wish to be blessed by the Lady in White.
{=str_tor_priest_hub_quit_p_cult_of_shallya}I must take my leave.
{=str_tor_priest_blessingshop_1_cult_of_shallya}For a small donation, you may access our tomes of healing and faith.
{=str_tor_priest_blessingshop_decline_cult_of_shallya}You should talk to an Alchemist first. There is much more to learn before I can show you how you can bless your equipment.
{=str_tor_priest_blessing_party_1_cult_of_shallya}In the name of Shallya, I bless you.
{=str_tor_priest_blessings_decline_cult_of_shallya}You have been blessed recently, there is no need of giving you the blessing of a god.

Also, consider a more generic string id because this can likely be used in a variety of conversations and save a bunch of duplicate or almost identical lines.

{=str_tor_teach_skills_dialog_p_DwarfRunelord}Can you teach my runesmith companion the sacred arts of the runes?
{=str_tor_skill_teacher_train_1_DwarfRunelord}I can help, but it will take a substantial amount of time and gold to do so.
{=str_tor_skill_teacher_train_2_DwarfRunelord}Would you still like me to pass down my teachings?
{=str_tor_skill_train_hub_select_companion_p_DwarfRunelord}Yes, please guide one of my companions.
{=str_tor_skill_train_hub_select_companion_DwarfRunelord}Very well, I will pass down my teachings. Your friend will be sent back when his training is finished.
{=str_tor_skill_train_hub_select_companion_decline_DwarfRunelord}There is nobody worth teaching in your party.
{=str_tor_priest_train_hub_quit_p_DwarfRunelord}Forgive me, Rhunrik, I've changed my mind.
{=str_tor_teach_skills_dialog_p_EngineerEmpire}Can you teach my companion more about Engineering?
{=str_tor_skill_teacher_train_1_EngineerEmpire}Sure. I can teach your companions. They will stay here. But I can tell this will cost you dearly

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_0}Such respect is not easily given, prove yourself under Grungni's stern gaze and we'll see if you are worthy.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_0}By Grungni's beard! It has been a long time indeed since I have seen someone with such potential.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_2}In the name of the Burudin, I hereby declare you part of the Rhunki. Take pride in your achievements, lad. Although I fear the celebrations will need to be postponed as desperate times call for desperate measures. And dark clouds are hanging above the Karaz Ankor.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_2}I am bound to the Grongaz, but you can travel and battle as you please. You have proven yourself worthy, and that is why I share with you my Anvil of Doom. But know this, there are binding oaths of secrecy cast upon it; one cannot simply abandon the Anvil. Protect it with your life.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_2}You may use it in battle as you see fit and unleash the ancient runes inscribed upon its surface, but be wary, its runes are powerful, and only the most skilled Rhunki can ever hope to awaken them. The most straightforward combination is the Rune of Hearth and Home. Never forget where you belong and where you came from.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_runelord_0}You get ahead of yourself, Rhunki. Not a long time ago we were still discussing the fundamentals, and now you think you derserve the title of a Runelord? Travel the Karaz Ankor, help our kin in need. Prove yourself worthy of this great honour.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_runelord}Not since the times of Thorek or even Kragg has a Rhunki displayed such skill in the arts of the runes!

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_hub_rune_lord_career_runelord2}As Thungni is my witness, henceforth you shall be known as a Rhunriki; may you walk with pride amongst the forges of our Ancestors. Now, let us discuss the secrets of the Third Rune…
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_buy_equipment}Take a look.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_deliver_steel}Those are always welcome, what do you wish to donate?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_deliver_steel_accept_p}Have a look.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_rune_smith_deliver_steel_decline_p}That will be all.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_1_start_runesmith}An unfamiliar face. What is it you want with our Rhunki?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_2_start_runesmith}A fellow Dawi! Welcome to the Grongaz.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_3_start_runesmith}{PLAYER_CLAN}, Dawongr! Do you have any business with the Rhunki?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_4_start_runesmith}Trusted member of {PLAYER_CLAN}! Know the Guild considers our partnership a great honour!
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_reintro_runesmith}Do you need anything else?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_1_start_miner}Greetings stranger, what do you want with our Boki?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_2_start_miner}A fellow Dawi! Welcome to the Miners Guild.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_3_start_miner}{PLAYER_CLAN}, Dawongr! Do you have any business with the Miners Guild
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_4_start_miner}Trusted members of {Player_Clan}! Know the Boki consider our partnership an honour!
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_reintro_miner}Did you need something else?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_1_start_engineer}An unfamiliar face. What is it you want with our Endrinkuli?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_2_start_engineer}A fellow Dawi! Welcome to the Engineers Guild.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_3_start_engineer}{PLAYER_CLAN}, Dawongr! Do you have any business with the Engineers Guild?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_4_start_engineer}Trusted members of {Player_Clan}! Know the Endrinkuli consider our partnership an honour!
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_reintro_engineer}Do you need something else?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_1_start_brewer}Greetings, old friend… or… we 'aven't met 'ave we? Hail, stranger.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_2_start_brewer}Dawi! Welcome to… to the… the Valdahaz!
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_3_start_brewer}{PLAYER_CLAN}, Dawongr! Ye 'ave business with me and our Guild? Come on in!
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_4_start_brewer}Friend?… MY FRIEND! My trusted drinking buddy! What can we do for ye!?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_reintro_brewer}Did ye need something else?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_1_start_warrior}An unfamiliar face. What is it you want with our longbeards?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_2_start_warrior}Fellow Dawi! Welcome to the Warriors Guild.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_3_start_warrior}{PLAYER_CLAN}, friends of the Dawi! Do you have any business with the Warriors Guild?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_4_start_warrior}Trusted members of {PLAYER_CLAN}. Know the Guild considers our partnership an honour!
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_reintro_warrior}Well, anything else?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_rune_smith}What do the Rhunki provide?

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_rune_smith}Ours is the oldest, wealthiest, and most powerful of the guilds. Founded in the time when the Ancenstor Gods still walked among us. We supply worthy Dawi with armour that could turn the blows of giants and weapons that could slay dragons in a single strike.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_rune_smith}In times of war, and only when the need arises, do we field the Anvils of Doom, capable of laying waste to entire armies. With our connections we can also reduce the costs of troops suited in Gromril gear, like Ironbreakers or Hammerers.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_miner}Can you explain the duties of the Miners Guild?

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_miner}Ours is one of the greatest and most venerated of all the Guilds. Founded by Grungni himself, the Miners Guild ensures that wherever there is a vein of gold or iron, there are Dawi to mine it.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_miner}Apart from that, we can boost the processing of ores and metals of your Grung, as well as deliver coal, gems, and iron every two weeks or so. Our more trusted members can also fund underground expeditions. Who can tell what long-lost treasures lie hidden in the depths…
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_brewer}What are the duties of the Brewers Guild?

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_brewer}What do ye think we do? We knit clothes an' pick pretty flowers. We make soddin' Gorog! We are the most important Guild of all the Guilds, there is nae Rhunrik or Endrinkuli or even a bleedin' Gov what ain't got alcohol in their body that ain't brewed by our Dawi.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_brewer}We can also help with army supplies. An' our ties with the Rangers allow certain armies to employ better scouts. Though our specialty lies in boosting the economy of Dawi Holds and ensuring all remain loyal and never grumble due to the lack of ale.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_engineer}What are the duties of your engineers?

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_engineer}We are one of the most important and powerful Guilds out there. Our engineers construct and maintain not only our grand Holds but also the various war machines of the Karaz Ankor.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_engineer}Apart from that, we help reduce maintenance costs of black powder units. The Guild also provides access to tried and tested prototype weaponry and artillery to various Dawi clans, but note we require you to first prove yourself.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_warrior}What are the duties of warriors within your Guild?

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_warrior}We are the largest of the guilds; any Dawi worth their weight in gold, be they miner or scout, underwent warrior training of some kind. If a warrior does exceptionally well, they might rise to become an Angthragor or even a Hammerer.

{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_info_p_warrior}Apart from that, we can help reduce upgrade costs of Warriors, Longbeards, and Slayers. Our connections also help you gain more Oathgold from battles and tournaments. Lastly, we are in charge of providing extra Dawi to help patrol the Karaz Ankor.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_hub_oath_gold_runesmith}Can I support the Rhunki?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_runesmith}Donations to the Burudin are always welcome.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_accept_p_runesmith}I wish to donate Oathgold.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_decline_p_runesmith}Forgive me, I changed my mind.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_end_runesmith}Thank you for your contribution.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_hub_oath_gold_runesmith}Can I support the Engineers Guild in some way?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_runesmith}Donations to the Guild are always welcome.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_accept_p_runesmith}I wish to donate Oathgold.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_decline_p_runesmith}I changed my mind, Master Engineer.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_end_runesmith}Thank you for your contribution.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_hub_oath_gold_miner}Can I support the Miners Guild in some way?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_miner}Donations to the Guild are always welcome.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_accept_p_miner}I wish to donate Oathgold.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_decline_p_miner}Forgive me, I changed my mind.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_end_miner}This is appreciated.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_hub_oath_gold_brewer}Can I support the Brewers Guild in some way?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_brewer}Donations to the guild are always appreciated.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_accept_p_brewer}I wish to donate Oathgold.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_decline_p_brewer}I changed my mind, Master Brewer.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_end_brewer}Thank ye for yer contribution.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_hub_oath_gold_warrior}Can I support the Warriors Guild?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_warrior}Donations to the guild are always welcome.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_accept_p_warrior}I wish to donate Oathgold.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_decline_p_warrior}Forgive me, Master Longbeard. I changed my mind.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_oath_gold_end_warrior}The Guild appreciates any contribution.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_hub_spend_troops_p}Can I provide you with troops to guard mining shafts?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_expedition_hub_found_artefacts_p}You find something of interest for me?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_expedition_hub_launch_expedition_p}Can I launch an expedition?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_hub_quit_p}That will be all, Master Boki.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_expedition_found_artefacts}Some of the explorer teams return with treasuers or artifacts. Naturally, a portion would be shared with you.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_expedition_found_artefacts}The expeditions have not returned yet.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_expedition_launch_expedition_decline}We are spread too thin; all we can do is wait for our explorers to return.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_expedition_launch_expedition_decline}Aye, with sufficient funding we can send teams to reclaim treasures from the deepest tunnels of the Underway.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_launch_expedition_accept_p}Let me fund an expeditions.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_launch_expedition_decline_p}Forgive me, I changed my mind.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_launch_expedition_end}Very well, our finest explorers and miners will depart after gathering supplies.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_spend_troops}Aye, the Guild will appreciate any help in this regard.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_spend_troops_accept_p}Let me station these men.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_spend_troops_decline_p}I changed my mind, forgive me.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_gemcutter_spend_troops_end}This is greatly appreciated, Dawongr.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_brewer_hub_spend_food_p}Can I deliver you some wheat to help brew ale?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_brewer_hub_quit_p}That will be all, Master Brewer.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_brewer_hub_spend_food}It is how we brew our finest ale. An' we can always use more Gertun.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_brewer_hub_spend_food_accept_p}Have these sacks of grain then.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_brewer_hub_spend_food_decline_p}Actually I changed my mind.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_brewer_hub_spend_food_end}Thank ye for yer contribution.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_hub_spend_troops_p}Can I leave some Dawi to help defend our Holds?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_influence_for_oath_p}Can you help improve my standing within the Karaz Ankor?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_hub_quit_p}That will be all, honoured longbeard.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_spend_troops}Honoured warriors of sure grip and stern eye are always welcome.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_spend_troops_accept_p}In that case I will leave these Dawi with you.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_spend_troops_decline_p}Forgive me, I changed my mind.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_spend_troops_decline_p}We appreciate any warrior you can spare.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_influence_for_oath}With a donation of Oathgold our warriors will spread the Influence of your Clan across the Karaz Ankor.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_influence_for_oath_decline_p}Actually I changed my mind.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_warrior_influence_for_oath_accept_p}We have a deal, that is a worthy trade.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_engineer_hub_quit_p}I hope you found what you were looking for. Come back anytime.
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_engineer_hub_buy_weapons_shop_p}Can the Guild share some of its inventions?
{=str_tor_dw_guildmaster_engineer_buy_weapons_shop}Very well. Here is what we were recently working on.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_party}{ROGUE_ENGINEER_NAME}s Part Thieves
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_first_time}You have the look of someone who has never seen a speck of black powder nor grease. Are you in the right place?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_done}Ah, you have returned. What news do you bring?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_in_progress}Come back when you have news.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_found}Did you find {ROGUE_ENGINEER_NAME}?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_start_rogue_engineer_hunt}Have you changed your mind and want to help hunt down {ROGUE_ENGINEER_NAME}?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hub_greet}You again, what do you want?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hub_player_cannons}I would like to buy some equipment.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hub_player_engineers}I would like to recruit some engineers.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hub_player_cannons_instruction}How can I use cannons?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hub_player_cannons_limit_instruction}How can I buy more cannons?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hub_player_leave}Nothing at the moment, I must leave.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_player_reconsider}I have reconsidered your offer, I would like to help.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_player_greet_0}Greetings Master Engineer, I am {PlAYERNAME}. I have come seeking access to the forges of Nuln. Can you help?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_player_greet_1}I am, I have come seeking access to black powder weapons.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_engineer_skill_check}Hah! You don't seem like a person with any knowledge of our crafts. What could you possibly need from us?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_engineer_skill_check_failed}I am far too busy for this, leave my sight.

{=str_tor_engineer_quest_engineer_skill_check_passed}These are the mightiest weapons of the Empire. The inventions of our Gunnery School are what held back the tide of darkness time and again. Normally we do not hand out our crafts to any who walks in, you have not earned our trust.

{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_briefing_0}We may however be able to come to an agreement, there is an internal matter that needs urgent attention and I am unable to act. If you help us out, as a personal favour, I will see what I can do for you. What say you?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_briefing_player}What would you have me do?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_briefing_decline}I don't have time for this.

{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_briefing_1}Usually we don't resort to outside assistance, but we are shorthanded. We have had some important components stolen from the forges of Nuln, and they must be returned. Immediately. If you can track down these runaways and find these parts then we can talk further.

{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_briefing_player_accept_0}I can, as long as our bargain remains the same. I will find him for you, and in return, you will allow me access to the forges of Nuln.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_briefing_player_accept_1}If this is the only way you will allow me access to the forges, then so be it. I will bring you his head.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_briefing_player_decline_0}I'm afraid not, I have other tasks to attend to.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_briefing_end}We have an agreement then, I believe I may know his whereabouts. I will mark it on your map for you, may Sigmar guide you stranger.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_player_accept_0}I understand, I will return the moment I have news.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_player_accept_1}That is all it will take? Sounds easy enough.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_player_decline}I do not have time for this.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_reaction_positive}Good, I expect positive results and your hasty return.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_reaction_negative}A shame, think on it and return if you change your mind.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_quest_fail}I am afraid I have failed to bring what you ask.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_quest_fail_answer}Tsk, I expected better. There may still be time, you can still track them if you are swift
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_quest_repeat}I won't let you down a second time.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_quest_giveup}I don't think I can do it at this time.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_return_0}I have returned but without the stolen components, I am afraid to say they are still missing.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_return_1}I see, this is not what I had hoped for. Were there any further clues, did you interrogate these scoundrels?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_return_2}One of the bandits did mention a name, {ROGUE_ENGINEER_NAME} I think?

{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_return_3}Blast! I should have known. If you are willing, I would ask for your assistance once more. This matter may be more dire than I originally imagined. {ROGUE_ENGINEER_NAME} is an engineer, a good one at that, but his works always seemed… wrong.

{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_quest_start}If he has stolen these parts, it can only mean some heinous scheme. I must ask that you track him down, and put an end to whatever madness he is trying to concoct. Will you assist us?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_in_progress_player}I have yet to track down the runaways.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_in_progress_answer}I see, return to me when you have something useful.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_hand_in}{ROGUE_ENGINEER_NAME} will no longer be a problem and I have retrieved what he stole from you. I'm unsure what he was trying to do with them.

{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_debrief}It matters not, it would have been something warped no doubt. I must thank you for your efforts, and your discretion. As agreed upon, you may now access our foundries and place orders as you please.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hub_entry}Now, what do you need?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_in_progress_player}I have yet to track him down
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_in_progress_answer}I see, return to me when you have better news.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_open_shop}Of course, you'll find only the best from the forges of Nuln!
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_close_shop}What else can I do for you?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hire_engineers}A pair of our novice engineers are eagier to join you for the right price ({RECRUITMENT_PRICE}).
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hire_engineers_accept}Welcome on board.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hire_engineers_not_enough_money}I don't have the funds for them right now.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_hire_engineers_decline}On second thought, maybe later.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cannons_limit_instruction_0}To buy cannons you must be an Imperial, that's the law.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cannons_limit_instruction_1}The amount of cannons you can field in your army increases every 50 levels in Engineering skill.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cannons_limit_instruction_2}If you have met these requirements, simply speak to me and I'll show you what we have.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cannons_use_0}Cannons are placed using the spellcasting Mode, but to fire the cannons you will need to hire at least two Cannon Crew
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cannons_use_1}You will also need to ensure that the cannon is in your party inventory
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cannons_use_2}Engineers and Cannon Crew can both fire cannons.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_encounter}{ROGUE_ENGINEER_NAME} was right, they sent someone after us! Grab your weapons quickly!
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_encounter_player_0}Woah, hold there, I have merely come for the stolen parts, there is no need for bloodshed. Perhaps an arrangement can be made?
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_encounter_player_1}Lay down your weapons and I may spare your lives.
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_encounter_player_2}Weapons or no, we will slay you all and take back what you stole!
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_cultist_encounter_answer}You will not trick us! They will serve a greater purpose! You will not take them!
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_encounter}So the old fool sent you after us? How did he figure out my plans? It matters not, you will not stand in the way of my creations. You will die here!
{=str_tor_engineer_quest_rogue_engineer_encounter_player_after_battle_answer} Your schemes end here.
{=str_tor_chaos_greeting}You will die drowning in a pool of your own blood!
{=str_tor_chaos_wounded_dialog_text}I will return!
{=str_tor_beastmen_greeting}We will trample your puny body beneath our hooves!
{=str_tor_beastmen_wounded_dialog_text}The dark gods have abandoned us!
{=str_tor_brokenwheel_greeting}You will be bathed in flames of Chaos and you will be happy!
{=str_tor_brokenwheel_wounded_dialog_text}The schemes of Tzeentch are endless, you have accomplished nothing!
{=str_tor_illumination_greeting}Come open the third eye, let me show you brother!
{=str_tor_illumination_wounded_dialog_text}You may have won the battle, but my life has been more successful than yours will ever be!
{=str_tor_secondflesh_greeting}I will spread my pox on your flesh!
{=str_tor_secondflesh_wounded_dialog_text}Today, death. Tomorrow, rebirth. The cycle cannot be stopped!
{=str_tor_druchii_greeting_neutral}What do you want, stranger? Speak quickly before you find yourself chained up in the bowels of my ship.
{=str_tor_druchii_greeting_war}It's you... The Masters of Karond Kar will be pleased indeed. Time to embrace your chains, slave!
{=str_tor_druchii_die}Our defeat is a mockery to Khaine.
{=str_tor_druchii_sell_slaves}Sell your prisoners as slaves ({RANSOM_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON})
{=str_tor_no_prisoners_to_sell_tooltip_text}You have no prisoners to sell.
{=str_tor_at_war_tooltip_text}You are at war with this faction.
{=str_tor_grail_companion_vow_start}Greetings my lord, how may I be of service?
{=str_tor_grail_companion_vow_1}It has been some time since you have come into my service, you have repeatedly proven to be a most capable and chivalrous Knight.
{=str_tor_grail_companion_vow_2}You honour me with your words my lord, it is my pride and pleasure to serve and fight alongside you.
{=str_tor_grail_companion_vow_3}I wish to bring you into my inner circle, to make you a leader and a trusted companion amongst my men; more than just a Knight in my service. What say you?
{=str_tor_grail_companion_vow_3_end}I look forward to our future battles together.
{=str_tor_grail_companion_vow_4}It would be my honour and in the name of the Lady I swear this; to serve you until my dying breath.
{=str_tor_grail_companion_vow_5}I look forward to our future battles together.
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_start_text}Aye what can I do for you?
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_partner_offer_text}Your employment has gone quite well and I want to bring you on as a partner.
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_partner_question_text}As a partner?
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_partner_terms_text}You get part of the share and need to accomplish a few advanced organisational matters. I will however not pay your wage anymore.

{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_demand_payment_text}First I want to see some hard coin. I am not playing Babysitter or 'Partner' without seeing some money first. You pay me {MERCCOMPANIONPRICE}{GOLD_ICON}
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_accept_payment_text}Of course, consider this a forward on your upcoming shares.
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_no_money_text}I don't have that in hand right now.
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_partnership_accepted_text}Thats a good deal, I am looking foward to this partnership.
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_keep_wage_text}Well then I stay with my current wage.
{=str_tor_mercenary_companion_wise_decision_text}What a wise decision!
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_peace_demand}The Lady demands that you stop slaughtering your fellow Bretonnians! ({PEACE_COST}{CHIVALRY_ICON})
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_demand_response1}Mylady, how dare you demand me... oh she does?
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_demand_response2}I guess, I can't deny your biding. If the lady demands, I will obey.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_war_demand}Our fair and noble land has been invaded! The lady demands that you strike her enemies!({WAR_COST}{CHIVALRY_ICON})
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_war_response1}Ah yeah so you know better, which thread bothers us most ?
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_war_response2}I guess, I can't deny you your biding. If the lady demands, I will obey.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_stop_war_faction1}Stop war with {FACTION_NAME_1}.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_stop_war_faction2}Stop war with {FACTION_NAME_2}.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_stop_war_faction3}Stop war with {FACTION_NAME_3}.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_nevermind}Actually never mind
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_unite_against_faction1}We need to unite against {FACTION_NAME_1}.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_unite_against_faction2}We need to unite against {FACTION_NAME_2}.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_unite_against_faction3}We need to unite against {FACTION_NAME_3}.
{=str_tor_grail_envoy_as_you_wish}As you wish Mylady.
{=str_str_culture_rich_name_khuzait}Vampire Counts
{=str_str_culture_rich_name_empire}Empire of Men

{=str_str_culture_description_khuzait}The Vampire Counts are fiends without equal. They seek to topple the civilisations of the living and supplant them with an Undead empire. Each Vampire is a unique and majestic figure with his own personality, drive and ambition. In contrast, their minions are mindlessly obedient - rank after rank of ragged and dirt-encrusted cadavers forced back to life by their masters' necromantic power.

{=str_str_culture_description_empire}The Empire of Man, the sprawling nation of humans dominating the Old World, faces a daily struggle for survival. Guided by their Emperor, Karl Franz, its armies stand as a testament to unwavering discipline and unmatched martial skills. In a world teeming with brutal savages and bloodthirsty monsters, the Empire endures thanks to the renowned discipline of its armies, honed through rigorous training and fortified by their unyielding faith in Sigmar. A beacon of human resilience, the Empire's soldiers exemplify the indomitable spirit of man that prevails amidst its endless list of foes.

{=str_str_culture_description_vlandia}The Kingdom of Bretonnia is a land renowned for powerful Knights and their strong sense of Chivalry. Guided by the Fey Enchantress and the Damsels of the Lady, the peasants toil while their noble lords protect them from the many dangers threating their survival. In times of war the whole kingdom can join together, led in a crusade against their enemies by King Louen Leoncoeur, against which no foe has known victory.

{=str_str_culture_description_mousillon}Mousillon, the accursed state nestled within the heart of Bretonnia, casts a dark and ominous shadow over the land. Once a proud dukedom, it now stands as a grim testament to the corruption that lingers in the shadows. Ruled by the Serpent of Mousillon, the realm of swamps and thickets contrasts against the vibrant setting of noble Bretonnia. Yet, even more tragic and unsettling are its mutated peasantry, ruled not by noble knights but the twisted undead, whose black knights evoke a chilling blend of traditional Bretonnian martial prowess and unholy power.

{=str_str_culture_description_battania}The Wood Elves are the elvish inhabitants of Athel Loren; they are a suspicious, isolationist and savage kin who live their lives surrounded by the nature of Athel Loren. Their magical forest home is as dangerous as it is beautiful, and its unforgiving nature has sharpened the skills of its people to a razor's edge. The Asrai live under the teachings of Isha and Kurnous as hunters and warriors defending the Weave and natural world, but darker voices ever seek to tempt them to slaughter and mayhem.

{=str_str_culture_description_eonir}Between Nordland and the Wasteland lies the forest of Laurelorn and it's inhabitants, the proud Eonir. They refused to flee the Old World with the rest of their kin and instead stood against and defeated the dwarfish advance on their forest. The Eonir live in a caste society split between the city and forest kin, and maintain their security through careful diplomacy; both with their neighbours and factions as far abroad as the Asur and the Druchii. Their governance works through layers of councils to promote a level of democracy. When the time for battle comes Eonir call on everything from the darkest magic to the purest spirits of the forest to ensure the safety of their home.

{=str_str_culture_description_sturgia}The Dwarfs, or the Dawi in their tongue, are one of the oldest and proudest races of the world. The Everlasting Realm of the Dwarfs was at its peak when human nations were nothing more than bands of warring barbarian tribes. Hardy, stout hearts combined with, at times, excessive pride result in a harsh and durable folk – one that is utterly incapable of forgiveness. And so the Dawi record each and every single wrong suffered at the hands of other races, with hopes of avenging said grudges in the future. Alas, this merciless and stubborn attitude led the Dwarfs into a number of conflicts that eventually pushed their civilization into decline. Out of 22 major Dwarfen Holds, or Karaks, only 12 remain under Dawi control – with the remaining ones fallen into the hands of their Ancestral Foes: Skaven and Greenskins.

{=str_str_culture_description_chaos_culture}No one truly knows the origin of Chaos in the mortal world. Even the long-lived scholars of the High Elves can only speculate as to where the forces of Chaos first originated. War, famine, natural disaster and the destroyer known as time have eroded away nearly all indications of the roots of Chaos.

{=str_str_culture_description_aserai}Orcs and Goblins have been a thorn in the side of every major and minor power for as long as anyone can remember. Caring nothing for history or legacy, in olden days the Greenskins were largely confined to the Southlands, where they waged savage wars amongst themselves, indifferent to the wider world. Yet this brutal isolation did not last. Earthquakes and volcanic activity drove them northwards in vast, rampaging hordes called Waaaghs!, looting and burning all in their path. The Dwarfs, weakened by the long and bitter War of Vengeance against the Elves, stood little chance against the green tide that washed over their homes, and many holds were lost. Ever since, Orcs and Goblins can be found in great numbers all over the planet, being outnumbered only by the Skaven, with whom they often wage wars deep underground.

{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_averland}I hereby swear to serve the Grand County of Averland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_averland}I proclaim the Elector Count, Marius Leitdorf as my rightful lord and better looking than Kurt Helboring.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_averland}I uphold my sword to protect the sun-kissed lands of Averland, its people, its cattle and above all: the sweet wines.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_averland}I recognise you as My lord and Saviour, and will follow you to the depths of hell and back and back to hell and… - ahem - back.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_hochland}I swear my loyalty to the Grand Barony of Hochland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_hochland}I acknowledge Aldebrand Ludenhof, the Grand Baron of Hochland and Baron of Hergig as my rightful ruler.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_hochland}Let Taal, Rhya and Sigmar guide me in my duty.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_hochland}Let my sword, shield and bow remain steady in the face of the enemy.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_middenland}I solemnly swear to serve the Grand Duchies of Middenland and Middenheim.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_middenland}I recognize Boris Todbringer, the Graf of Middenheim, the Grand Duke of Middenland, and the Prince of Carroburg as my lord and commander.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_middenland}May Ulric, the Lord of Winter, guide my steps and lead me to victory for this great province.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_middenland}I shall not rest until the enemy is no more or the Great Wolf claims me in death.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_ostermark}I swear my loyalty to the League of Ostermark, the East March.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_ostermark}I acknowledge Elector Count Wolfram Hertwig, Chancellor of the League of Ostermark and Prince of Bechafen, as my liege.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_ostermark}As long as I draw breath, I vow to keep the mutant and undead foe at bay.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_ostermark}I pledge to always work for the benefit of this realm and its stout citizens.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_ostland}I hereby swear to serve the Grand Principality of Ostland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_ostland}May my service to Valmir von Raukov, Grand Prince of Ostland, Margrave of the Northern March, and Hammer of the East allow me to crush our enemies.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_ostland}Grant me the opportunity to fight for you until I rest in Morr’s embrace.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_ostland}Let us slay the wolf at the door and protect the people of Ostland!
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_stirland}I hereby swear loyalty to the Grand County of Stirland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_stirland}I acknowledge Alberich Haupt-Anderssen, Grand Count of Stirland, Prince of Wurtbad and Overlord of Sylvania as my lord and liege until my dying day.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_stirland}May my body be Stirland’s shield in defence of the undead threat.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_stirland}I will follow you to the deepest parts of the dead lands.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_wasteland}I hereby swear fealthy to the mercantile city-state of the Wasteland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_wasteland}I will fight with the blessing of Manann for the sea is my home.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_wasteland}My blood is filled with salt and my pockets are filled with gold for i am a Marienburger.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_wasteland}The debt will be repaid!
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_wissenland}I hereby swear my loyalty to Nuln, Bastion of the South and the Jewel of the Empire and the lesser surrounding villages, castles and towns of Wissenland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_wissenland}I recognise Emmanuelle von Liebwitz, Grand Countess of Wissenland, Countess of Nuln and Duchess of Meissen as my eternal lady.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_wissenland}In times of dire need, i will defend Nuln to the best of ability.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_wissenland}I pledge to follow you wherever you lead and will defend you till my dying day.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_talabecland}I hereby swear undying loyalty to the Grand Duchy of Talabecland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_talabecland}I recognise Helmut Feuerbach, Grand Duke of Talabecland, Margrave of the East March and Beloved of Taal as my eternal lord.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_talabecland}In times of need, I will defend the Taalbaston until my dying breath.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_talabecland}I shall aid you in defence of Taal’s holy ground until the end of days.

{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_reikland}I hereby swear eternal servitude to Reikland and its sovereign, Karl Franz Holswig-Schliestein, Protector of the Empire, Defier of the Dark, Sigmar's Heir, Emperor of the South, and Son of Emperors.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_reikland}I pledge my soul to the warrior god Sigmar, his foes will know my wrath.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_reikland}May your foes recognise me as their eternal enemy, for as long as there is breath within my body I will not rest.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_reikland}All hail to Karl Franz, whom I will follow into the depths of the abyss.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_moot}I hereby swear to serve the Grand County of the Mootland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_moot}I proclaim the elder Hisme Stoutheart as my rightful liege.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_moot}I uphold my sword to protect the people against the undead menace.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_moot}I pledge to aid you in peace and in times of war alike.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_nordland}I proclaim to serve the Grand Barony of Nordland.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_nordland}I acknowledge Elector Count Theoderic Gausser, Grand Baron of Nordland, Prince of Salzenmund as my rightful liege and commander.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_nordland}I swear to protect the fine province of Nordland, its shorelines, harbors and forests, from anyone and anything that dares threaten it.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_nordland}May Manann, Ulric, Taal and Sigmar guide me on this path…
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_sylvania}I Pledge mine soul to the eternal servitude of the lands of Sylvania.

{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_sylvania}I hereby sweareth mine undying loyalty to Mannfred von Carstein, Count of Sylvania, the most cunning and magically gifted vampire of all of the von Carstein bloodlines.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_sylvania}May thine enemies tremble at the sight of me and mine undead legions.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_sylvania}I shall join thine court and follow thee deep into the lands of the empire.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_anguille}With the lady as my witness, i shall swear loyalty to the salt bitten lands of L'anguille
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_anguille}Duke Taubert will be my Liege and in times of need i will flock to his banner.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_anguille}As a knight and as a seafahrer, i will protect the land and coast of L'anguille that i vow.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_anguille}Blessed by the lady we will overcome!
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_artois}I give my hearth and dedication to the protection of the forest lands of the dukedom of Artois.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_artois}My sword and lance are yours Duke Chilfroy for i am your subject.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_artois}My shield is for the people of Gisoreux whom i will protect with my body and soul, for i am pure a true knight of Bretonnia.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_artois}As a knight of Gisoreux no harm will overcome my people this i vow.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_aquitaine}With honour, I swear allegiance to the majestic Dukedom of Aquitaine.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_aquitaine}I shall follow the guidance of the esteemed Duke Armand, a paragon of chivalry and virtue.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_aquitaine}I dedicate my sword to protect Aquitaine's fertile fields, its people, and the rich traditions of chivalry.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_aquitaine}As a loyal knight, I shall stand tall against any foe, preserving the honour and grace that defines Aquitaine.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_bastonne}With honour and humility, I pledge my service to the noble Dukedom of Bastonne.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_bastonne}I declare my loyalty to the honourable Duke Bohemond, a beacon of courage and chivalry.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_bastonne}I shall defend the land of Bastonne, its brave knights, and the legendary lands hold sacred by our Lady of the Lake.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_bastonne}As a true knight of Bastonne, I shall uphold the virtues of chivalry and valour, safeguarding the realm and its cherished traditions.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_bordeleaux}With great honour, pledge my unwavering loyalty to the majestic Dukedom of Bordeleaux.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_bordeleaux}I proclaim my allegiance to Duke Alberic, a visionary leader whose passion for prosperity and warfare knows no equal under our Lady.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_bordeleaux}I vow to protect the fertile vineyards of Bordeleaux, its people, and its wine.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_bordeleaux}In the name of chivalry and valour, I shall ride forth as a true knight of Bordeleaux, defending our lands with my life.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_brionne}With honour and humility, I swear fealty to the noble Dukedom of Brionne.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_brionne}I declare my loyalty to Duke Theodoric, a wise and just ruler beloved by his subjects.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_brionne}I shall safeguard the beautiful lands of Brionne, its people, and the magnificant castles that grace the countryside.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_brionne}As a true knight of Brionne, I shall uphold the virtues of honour and loyalty, protecting our dukdom from any who would threaten its beauty and arts.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_carcassonne}I hereby pledge my undying loyalty to the valiant Dukedom of Carcassonne.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_carcassonne}I proclaim my allegiance to Duke Huebald, a gallant leader whose deeds inspire us all.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_carcassonne}I vow to protect the fields of Carcassonne, its brave knights, and its adept armies.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_carcassonne}As a loyal defender of Carcassonne, I shall stand steadfast in preserving the honour and valour of our beloved realm.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_couronne}I pledge my loyalty and life to the majestic dukedom of Couronne
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_couronne}I vow to protect, serve and follow The king of Brettonia King Louen Leoncoeur.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_couronne}I'm the king his subject and his to command.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_couronne}All hail King Louen Leoncoeur!
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_gisoreux}I swear to protect the honourable lands of the dukedom Gisoreux.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_gisoreux}My banners shall wear the colours of my duke Hagen, for i am his servant and i will aid in his will.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_gisoreux}I shall guard the mountain tops of the Pale sisters and the plains of Gisoreux as i would defend my family.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_gisoreux}As a true son of Gisoreux, i will uphold the values of Gisoreux and die for its glory.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_lyonesse}I offer my sword and shield to the blessed dukedom of Lyonesse.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_lyonesse}I will vow to support Duke Adalhard in his rule over Lyonesse.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_lyonesse}I will ride down my enemies, and defend the holy land of Lyonesse.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_lyonesse}As a knight of Lyonesse i will fight with the courage of a lion, I shall be the pillar that uphold our values and legacy.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_montfort}I pledge my unwavering loyalty to the noble Dukedom of Montfort.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_montfort}I proclaim my allegiance to Duke Folcard, a courageous leader whose valour is as hardy as the many mountains he rules over.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_montfort}I vow to protect the majestic lands of Montfort, its people, and the towering castles that stand as symbols of our strength.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_montfort}With unwavering dedication, I shall serve as a true knight of Montfort, defending our realm's honour and sovereignty with every breath.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_parravon}I hereby swear fealty to the illustrious Dukedom of Parravon.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_parravon}I pledge my loyalty to Duke Cassyon, the valiant defender of our mountains and forests.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_parravon}I shall safeguard the sacred lands of Parravon, its people, and its beloved pegasi.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_parravon}As a devoted knight of Parravon, I shall stand as a beacon of hope, defending our realm and upholding our dukedom's legacy.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_quenelles}With honour and humility, I swear allegiance to the noble Dukedom of Quenelles.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_quenelles}I declare my loyalty to Duke Tancred II, a wise and resolute leader who inspires us all.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_quenelles}I vow to protect the lands of Quenelles, its people, and the sacred shrines that honour the Lady of the Lake.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_quenelles}As a true knight of Quenelles, I shall embrace the ideals of chivalry, defending our realm and preserving its timeless grace and beauty.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_mousillon}I, a humble knight, pledge my unwavering loyalty to the realm of Mousillon.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_mousillon}I vow to serve the Dukedom's ruler, the Serpent, and embrace the shadows that shroud this land.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_mousillon}I shall defend the people of Mousillon and the forgotten spirits that linger amidst the darkness.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_mousillon}I recognise you, my sovereign lord, and will stand resolute in the face of the world's disdain for our home, united under your banner.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_blooddragons}I hereby swear loyalty to Wallach Harkon, the Ordo Draconis and my fellow knights.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_blooddragons}I hereby swear my blade to the complete destruction of humankind and any other who opposes the power of the vampires.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_blooddragons}May I always sate my sword's thirst for blood and seek out the greatest of our foes.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_blooddragons}I will never retreat from battle and I will be loyal to you or suffer the consequences of betrayal.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_necrachs}Upon this baleful night, I do swear mine eternal allegiance to the Necrarch bloodline, and mine Lord, Zacharias the Everliving.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_necrachs}I dedicate mine mind to the pursuit of the arcane, and I bind mine spirit to the essence of magic.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_necrachs}With tomes of old, I will navigate the shadows, unlock the whispers and secrets long forgotten.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_necrachs}As thou dost guide mine fate through this accursed unlife.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_laurelorn}Your Majesty, in this sacred moment, I stand before you, deeply honored by your presence.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_laurelorn}I pledge to protect the harmony of our land, nurture its magic, and preserve its beauty that binds us all.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_laurelorn}In the presence of shimmering streams and ancient trees, I commit to being a guardian of our realm.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_laurelorn}May Laurelorn, Queen Marrisith, and Eonir flourish and prosper forevermore!
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_athel_loren}I swear to protect the kingdom of Athel loren.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_athel_loren}I shall be Athel loren's bow and she shall be my arrow.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_athel_loren}I swear fealthy to the king and queen of the forest Orion and Ariel and i will answer their horn in times of need.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_athel_loren}May the roots of the forest guide me!
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line1_brasskeep}Forged in plague we rise from decay.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line2_brasskeep}With the plague lord's gifts we march into the fray.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line3_brasskeep}From death our power grows.
{=str_tor_feudal_oath_line4_brasskeep}In Nurgle's name we will deliver death!

{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_empire}I proclaim you a noble of the Empire. Your life and property shall be protected by our laws, and shall not be taken from you except by law. You may serve as an official over towns and villages and as a general over armies, if we call upon you to do so.
{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_khuzait}I proclaim you a noble of the Sylvania and a servant of the von Carsteins. You are expected to carry out our bidding and bear arms in times of war.
{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_mousillon}I have great hopes for you {PLAYER.NAME}. I know you shall prove yourself worthy of the trust I have placed in you.
{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_blooddragons}Welcome to the Ordo Draconis {PLAYER.NAME}. Here are some of my followers, may they aid you in battle. Take this blade.
{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_vlandia}By the lady of the lake. I proclaim you a noble of Brettonia and defender of the realm.
{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_battania}I name you guardian of Athel Loren, noble of the Asrai, may thy bow aim true.
{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_eonir}I proclaim you a noble of the Eonir, stand proud for you are now a protector of the holy forest of Laurelorn.
{=str_tor_player_accept_vassalage_chaos_culture}May Nurgle gift you with his blessings.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_empire}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the house of {CLAN_NAME}.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_empire}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of the house of {CLAN_NAME}. Our family has served the Empire for generations.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_empire_honor}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of the house of {CLAN_NAME}. Our family has discharged its duties honorably since the days of Sigmar himself.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_empire_mercy}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of the house of {CLAN_NAME}. Though one should not be too proud of one's lineage, I am glad to say that we have always taken seriously our duty to protect the common folk of the Empire.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_empire_boasting}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of the house of {CLAN_NAME}, one of the most illustrious families in the annals of the Empire.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_empire_boasting_cruel}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of the house of {CLAN_NAME}, one of the most illustrious families in the annals of the Empire. What is best in life? To crush your enemies. See them driven before you. And to hear the lamentations of their women.
{=str_str_comment_intro_cruel_khuzait}Know that if you ever cross me, you'll wind up as undead fodder in our armies.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_khuzait}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the {CLAN_NAME}.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_khuzait_boasting}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of the {CLAN_NAME}. I am sure you have heard the name of our clan whispered in fear among the soldiers of the Empire.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_khuzait}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of the {CLAN_NAME}. Our clan has loyally served the von Carsteins for generations.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_khuzait_boasting_blooddragon_honor}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. I stay mine hand only due to personal ideals, speak quickly.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_khuzait_boasting_blooddragon}You seem weak, I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Are you ready to die?

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_khuzait_blooddragon_cruel}You find yourself before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}, What trifling mongrel comes to me? Speak! Or I will have thine corpse splayed on the battlements of Blood Keep.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_khuzait_blooddragon_mercy}Weakling, my lord Walach would bade me to slaughter you. I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Speak quickly before I perform my duties.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_vlandia}Well met, I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of {CLAN_NAME}.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_vlandia}Well met, I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. My family has served the people of Bretonnia and the Lady for generations
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_vlandia_honor}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Come, be ye friend or foe come and let me hear what you have to say.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_vlandia_mercy}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. My lord instructs me to show mercy to no one, yet you do not seem like a threat to my cause.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_vlandia_boasting}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Speak quickly, I have no patience for those with little ambition.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_vlandia_boasting_cruel}Who dares to come before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Peons, beggars and cowards have no right to tread the ground I walk on. Speak or be slain.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_mousillon}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the house of {CLAN_NAME}.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_mousillon}You come before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of {CLAN_NAME}
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_mousillon_honor}You come before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. You seem a capable foe, well met.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_mousillon_mercy}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. My lord instructs me to show mercy to no one, yet you do not seem like a threat to my cause.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_mousillon_boasting}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Speak quickly, I have no patience for those with little ambition.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_mousillon_boasting_cruel}Who dares to come before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Peons, beggars and cowards have no right to tread the ground I walk on. Speak or be slain.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_battania}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of the realm of {CLAN_NAME}.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_battania}You come before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK} of {CLAN_NAME}
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_battania_honor}You come before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Our realm has stood the test of time since the Sundering.

{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_battania_mercy}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. My lord instructs me to show mercy to no one, yet you do not seem like a threat to my cause.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_battania_boasting}I am {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}. Speak quickly, I have little patience for insignificance.
{=str_str_comment_noble_introduces_self_and_clan_battania_boasting_cruel}Who dares to come before {CONVERSATION_CHARACTER.LINK}, of {CLAN_NAME}?

{=str_tor_customsettlement_intro_haunted_site_01}Verhungern by local Slyvanians, this dispersed land is a ghoul, and likely spirit, infested maze of briars and bogs. Only the insane or desperate would venture into its boughs.
{=str_tor_customsettlement_disabled_haunted_site_01}You shouldn't see this.

{=str_tor_customsettlement_intro_haunted_site_02}Destroyed by unholy fire that rained from the skies eons ago, Hel Fenn is likely the most cursed area in the whole Reik Basin. Molded buildings, rotting trees and tar covered corpses dot the desolate landscape. This was also the site of Mannfred von Carsteins defeat and the end of the Vampire Wars.
{=str_tor_customsettlement_disabled_haunted_site_02}You shouldn't see this.

{=str_tor_customsettlement_intro_haunted_site_03}Long have the hills southeast of Talabheim been cursed. Strangeness and tragedy are no stranger to that land. Despite this, no one knows what the cause of the miasma is; though not for lack of trying.
{=str_tor_customsettlement_disabled_haunted_site_03}You shouldn't see this.

{=str_tor_customsettlement_intro_haunted_site_04}Centuries ago, the hills outside of Mousillon were used as a mass grave to bury the thousands who died of Red Pox. So many victims were there that to this day the soil covering their pits is visible from the city walls. The air here is sometimes poisonous and like the rest of the cursed land the long dead rest uneasily.
{=str_tor_customsettlement_disabled_haunted_site_04}You shouldn't see this.
