{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_0}My story? Sure, I can share it.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_0}As a boy I discovered I was not like most children, it was not long before the colleges realised this as well.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_0}Once my affinity for Aqshy was known, I was ripped from my peasant life and become an initiate within the Colleges in Altdorf.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_0}That fire in Altdorf a few years back that started in a tavern? Definitely wasn't me!.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_0}Most interesting.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_0}I am a licensed Bright Wizard from the Colleges in Altdorf. I'm sure by now you have met a few of us and may know how powerful we can be.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_1}The story of my life is insignificant, but I will speak.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_1}I was an Orphan left at the doors of the Church, the Cult of Sigmar took me in and raised me.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_1}I have studied many holy scriptures and dedicated my life to the never-ending battle against the filth of Chaos.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_1}I roam the countryside and purge heresy with unwavering determination.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_1}This has my consent.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_1}Have you finished?
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_1}I'm a warrior priest of Sigmar and no corruption will escape my wrath.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_2}It is not much of a tale, but I will speak of my life.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_2}My mother worked in a brothel, we barely had enough to eat. Never knew my father.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_2}I had to learn to defend myself from drunken clients at a very young age. My mother wouldn't leave no matter how much I begged her.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_2}One day things went too far, one of her clients was trying to take her life in some kind of strange ritual. I stole his knife and ended it, soon after I left and joined the Templars.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_2}You are doing Sigmar's work!
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_2}That is downright pitiful.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_2}I am a Witch Hunter, a Templar of Sigmar. The guilty cannot escape me.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_3}My story isn't that unique, but I don't mind talking about it.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_3}I was born the child of a hedge wizard, when I too showed magical affinity I was sent to the Colleges.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_3}I was always top of my classes. The others accused me of hubris, but they were merely blinded by their mediocrity.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_3}You cannot find a more promising wizard in the realms of the Empire. I am on the path to surpass Balthazar Gelt himself!
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_3}I see.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_3}Pff, how ridiculous.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_3}I am a Light Wizard from the Imperial Colleges. I have no doubts that you have heard of our immense skill.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_4}My story isn't that unique, but I don't mind talking about it.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_4}I was born the child of a hedge wizard, when I too showed magical affinity I was sent to the Colleges.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_4}I was always top of my classes. The others accused me of hubris, but they were merely blinded by their mediocrity.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_4}You cannot find a more promising wizard in the realms of the Empire. I am on the path to surpass Balthazar Gelt himself!
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_4}I see.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_4}Pff, how ridiculous.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_4}I am a Celestial Wizard from the Imperial Colleges. I have no doubts that you have heard of our immense skill.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_5}I was born into a family of serfs, but working the fields was no life for me!
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_5}I became the apprentice of a master alchemist, but the bastard taught me nothing yet worked me to death for years.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_5}I left him on the side of the road when his wagon broke down one day and joined the army where I learned to maintain equipment. Explosives are my newly found passion.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_5}Most interesting.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_5}Have you finished?
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_5}I am an Engineer experienced in the operation and maintenance of gunpowder weapons.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_6}Who I am is second to what I do, I tend to those in need.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_6}It has always been my calling to help the sick and wounded, my parents died when I was young and I do not wish for others to experience such pain.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_6}I dedicated my life to Shallya, in return I have been given a gift for healing others.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_6}Since I have been travelling the Empire, looking to where my skills are needed most. Tending to peasant and soldier alike.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_6}I see.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_6}I understand.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_6}I am a Priestess of the Goddess Shallya, dedicated to the arts of healing.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_7}You don't need to know my story stranger, just my skills.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_7}I'm a Court Huntsman, well. I was. Lets just say I missed my mark by the rump of a noble.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_7}Now I track, hunt and do mercenary work for coin.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_7}I have hunted all manner of beast and beastmen, even the occasional orc. My skills go to the highest bidder.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_7}Mhmm…
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_7}I am a Huntsman, many monsters have been slain by my hand in service of the Empire.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_8}What matters is my tale, not my name…
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_8}I was admitted to the esteemed Golden College, and quickly distinguished myself among the apprentices.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_8}My command of the Wind of Chamon was nearly flawless. Yet, soon Balthasar Gelt arrived, eclipsing all others with his skill. I could have been the greatest Gold Wizard the Empire has ever seen.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_8}And yet, not all is lost. I have amassed invaluable knowledge at the College and shall prove my worth across the Old World, while he occupies some dusty seat on some council.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_8}Yes… of course.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_8}Looks like I'll have to settle for the second best Metal Wizard.

{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_empire_8}Do not let appearances deceive your eyes; in a short time, I will surpass Gelt. You shall all see. In the meantime, I must hone my skills, preferably by the side of someone competent. Additionally, I expect certain comforts to be assured.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_8}I am a Metal Wizard of the Imperial College, master spellcaster and alchemist.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_9}Life is full of questions. I will answer yours.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_9}My home was the Drakwald Forest — it's where I was raised and where I felt the nourishing Wind of Ghyran for the first time. People also call us druids.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_9}I look after all things natural and heal the injured, for my magic is one of restoration, not mindless destruction.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_9}My mission is to uphold the balance between the Empire and nature that feeds us.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_9}A most important duty.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_9}I am a Life Wizard of the Imperial College. No doubt you have heard of our immense healing capabilities.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_10}You have a curious smell, traveler. Will you listen to my story?
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_10}When I was young, I felt a strong connection with all kinds of woodland creatures. And soon I learned to converse with them.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_10}When the villagers found out, they charged me with heresy and wished to burn me at the stake. Fortunately, I escaped and hid with the animals in the forest.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_10}After a long time in isolation, a wizard of the Amber Order found and invited me to come along. It was him that taught me these abilities don't make you a spawn of Chaos. Instead, they mean blessings of the Wind of Ghur.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_10}Citizens of the Empire can be cruel.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_10}No wonder you live in isolation.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_10}I am a Beast Wizard of the Imperial College. You have certainly heard of our might and talent for survival.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_11}Hmmm. I smell the battle in you. You've shed blood for sure, I perceive it in you.

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_11}I am the Winter's God loyal warrior. I come from the far north of the Empire, where the ground is gray, frost is everlasting, and corpses take an eternity to rot.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_11}Ulric is my father. I owe my strength and my powers to him. And I will shed blood for him whenever the opportunity arises.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_11}Will you be the one who helps me fulfill my purpose, traveler?
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_11}If your purpose is blood, we share the same destiny, my friend.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_11}I don't care about your motivations, but rather your abilities.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_empire_11}Alright then. If the price is right - my axe is yours, as is the wisdom of the winter.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_11}I am a priest of Ulric. You have certainly heard of our fighting skills.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_12}I see you lead a war party, eh. Hope you're not like those sons of nobles that I've had the misfortune of knowing.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_12}I have spent much of my life commanding a wealthy nobleman's army. A great honor, they said… Bah! Bullshit.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_12}They've put me as captain subordinate to that noble's son, a beardless kid who knew nothing about commanding. He didn't even know how to get on a horse. I followed that stupid boy's instructions and it almost cost me my life. But unlike my men, I still have air in my lungs to denounce this negligence.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_12}Of course that daddy's boy, hidden in his mommy's skirts, said the failure was due to my incompetence, and that I didn't know how to lead. The bastard didn't even show up in battle, he just gave the order to charge and that's it.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_12}I've also had the misfortune of dealing with those types of commanders.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_12}I'm sorry for your men.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_empire_12}Ah, fuck him! Now that I don't have that posh man in charge, I'd join a company whose commander has some brains. I hope you can be.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_12}I am a Captain of the Imperial Army. No doubt you've heard of our commanding talent.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_empire_13}With great pleasure.

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_empire_13}I am the youngest of 5 brothers. My older brother is the one chosen by my father, a renowned baron of the Empire, to inherit the title and possessions of my family. Then comes my other brother, the second oldest, who thanks to my family name, got a position in the administration in the government of one ot the provinces, no less.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_empire_13}My third brother enlisted in the imperial army. My father served before him, and that's why they gave him preferential treatment, giving him the position he left. My sister joined the priestesses of Shallya, something very honorable.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_empire_13}And only I am left, without the possibility of inheriting anything or favored treatment. Being forced to start from the bottom like any commoner if I want to become something in life.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_empire_13}Certainly my men enjoy opportunities to fill themselves with gold and glory.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_empire_13}We all have our place in life.

{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_empire_13}I was trained in combat since I was little. I know how to handle the sword, the greatsword, the crossbow and firearms. I also know the letters. I can speak and write fluently in the language of the Empire, Bretonnia and Tilea. You will not find a better candidate.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_empire_13}I am a member of Imperial nobility. No doubt I am an educated and righteous person, not some mere foolish commoner.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_0}Hm, you wish to know of my life? It is a tale I can share.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_vampire_0}I have always been surrounded by death, death is everything in Sylvania.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_vampire_0}My fate was never to join the undead roaming the land, but to control them. To raise them and bend them to my will.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_vampire_0}It has taken time but the dead do my bidding and my powers are ever growing.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_vampire_0}I couldn't really care less about your wretched origin.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_0}I am a master of death and undeath, many fear me. Do you?
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_1}I do not remember much of my past life, there is only the now and the thirst.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_vampire_1}Being human feels like a dream, a dream I was happily liberated from.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_vampire_1}I was taken from my village for the blood tax, but instead I became the desire of my vampire master. I was blessed with the gift of Nagash
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_vampire_1}My master however perished during the vampire wars, with no one else I have been left to wander the night since.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_vampire_1}I couldn't really care less about your wretched origin.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_1}I'm a fledgeling Vampire, powerful and undying.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_vampire_2}Shattered memories, warrior, soldier? So long ago.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_vampire_2}Much is lost, bloodshed, battle, death.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_vampire_2}I serve, I fight, I destroy.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_vampire_2}I see.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_vampire_2}Riiight…
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_2}I am a Wight King, servant in death.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_3}Ah, You'd like to hear my story? Very well.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_vampire_3}As you eyes can clearly see, I am a vampire countess.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_vampire_3}However, I sit and wait to see if anybody here is worthy of my time, as tending to the politics of Nefertatas brood bores me to no end.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_vampire_3}And trust me, if you are interested, my services will indeed be very valuable.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_vampire_3}I suppose.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_vampire_3}Well, what do you say then?
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_3}I am a Lahmian countess, and not only can I hold myself in battle, but I would be great use to you during travel.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}Darling, are you lost?
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}Oh, I don't have a story. I've lived a long time, and I can sense when someone is about to die. I see death in you and in those around you.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}Your soul is dark, like a look at Morrslieb's moon. (She holds your hand tightly.)
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}May your god turn his back on you and your body be dragged to the scaffold where a flock of crows will tear out your eyes and devour you alive!
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}I don't believe in curses, but I've heard about the knowledge of the Strigani witches.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}Take your calloused hands off me!
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}We Strigani matriarchs are wise, you would do well to fear us. We know every path to tread, every herb that can heal, and which poison is best disguised.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_vampire_4}Although, for the right price, I can help you on your travels. And I might be able to lift your curse.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_0}I have no qualms speaking of my life stranger.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_0}I was born into a noble family from Carcassonne, my father was a Knight before me.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_0}It is my duty to become a Knight and I am currently on my quest to gain the favour of the Lady.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_0}I have only just set out on my journey, I have much to learn.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_0}I hope you will achieve what you set out to do.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_0}You shouldn't have wandered so far from home.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_0}I am a questing Knight, devoted in life to the Lady and Bretonnia.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_1}Who I am is second to what I do, I tend to those in need.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_1}It has always been my calling to help the sick and wounded, and like many others, I was rescued and trained for my affinity with the winds of magic.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_1}I dedicated my life to the Lady, in return I have been given a gift for aiding her knights.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_1}Since then I have been travelling the lands, looking to where my skills are needed most and tending to peasant and soldier alike.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_1}I see.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_1}I understand.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_2}Well say no more. Do you wanna share a pint while listening to the exploits of a true warrior?

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_2}I haven't always been what you see now. Not long ago I was a servant of our beloved Bretonnia. I cultivated the grain that grew on these fertile lands, I had a small cabin in a village and I paid the duke's extortioners when they came to collect protection, rents, tolls or whatever they invented.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_2}And so, deluded to me, I'd have continued if it had not been for a pack of beastmen that plundered our village. Or so they tried. It turns out that the true strength of a countryman reveals in combat. And with nothing more than my tools I was able to kill a handful of those foul beings. Without realizing it, I was able to inspire enough courage in my neighbors that they joined the fight.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_2}And I wonder: where were the duke's soldiers who should've been protecting us? What is our miserable salary spent on? With my hut destroyed and people cheering me, I decided that this scoundrel was not going to get any more money from me. And I don't regret it, with a couple of hireling contracts I earn more than an entire year in the field.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_2}A real hero among the peasants, without a doubt.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_2}You know, there are much worse enemies than a bunch of ungors out there.

{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_2}I've already proven myself in combat, now I'm just looking for a commander to serve who won't treat me like just another levy soldier. Well, my reputation precedes me.

{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_3}Listen, I need to get away from this place as soon as possible. Not long ago I was hunting in one of the nearby woods, and then I heard some screaming. I ran to see what was happening and found myself at a small farm.

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_3}There were a couple of poorly equipped soldiers beating up the farmer. Meanwhile an ugly bastard who seemed to be their chief dragged a woman to a shed behind.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_3}Maybe I'm not the most honorable guy in Bretonnia, but even I know there are lines that shouldn't be crossed.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_3}Sneaking up on the chief, I stabbed him in the back. But I couldn't deal with the other two. Well, at least I distracted them from that poor woman by chasing me. Now I spend my days hiding in places like this, trying to avoid the scaffold.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_3}In this cruel world, no good deed goes unpunished.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_3}You wanted to avoid one crime by committing another. You're not that different from that guy.

{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_3}Maybe you're right… If only you accepted me into your army they would stop looking for me, and I could stop hiding. I would be eternally grateful to you.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_4}Greetings, is there a noble sending you who needs an architect?

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_4}There's not much to tell about me. I learned the trade from my father, who was a Wall Warden before me, as was his grandfather before him, and his father before him…

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_4}I had the knowledge and experience of several years building and maintaining the walls and towers of the cordon sanitaire that protect us from those cursed people of Mousillon. But Bretonnian lords also frequently hired me to build their own castles.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_4}Have you been to Turris Vigilans? I was in charge of designing its new wall. The previous one would not have withstood a siege. Have you been to Libourne Castle? The lord there hired me to expand and renovate the fortress's rooms.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_4}I'm sure you've won the sympathy of many dukes.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_4}Can your architectural knowledge be of any use to me in a battle?
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_4}I know the secrets of fortifications. Just as I know how to build them, I also know the quickest way to destroy them.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_5}}Greetings. Are you by any chance looking for people interested in a large enterprise?

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_5}I've traveled throughout the Old World, working in the sale and transportation of goods and merchandise. I have experience in logistics, am adept at trading and bargaining, and am fluent in languages ​​and personal contact.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_5}My services have been requested before by bourgeois and noble people; and throughout my travels, I have traveled with all sorts of diverse characters.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_5}Other merchants, doctors, warriors… I even once shared the journey with a group of troubadours who enlivened the journey with their performing talents. Ah, I'll never forget their incomparable performance while singing 'West Bretonnia'. A delight to my ears.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_5}I've heard of those wandering troubadours.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_5}I don't know what you mean. But you seem to know what you're talking about.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_bretonnia_5}Anyway, I recently finished my contract with a lucrative profit, and I'm open to a new contract.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}Hmmph. You'd like to hear my story?
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}I was one of those questing knights a long time ago, dedicating my entire life for that damned Lady.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}But years pass, quest after quest, kill after kill, she still does not think I'm worthy! The bastard!
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}So now I no longer follow that road of religion and lip service, I instead look for whoever has the heaviest pouch of coin.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}Very intruiging.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}I hope that is the only thing you're looking for.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}Well, don't waste my time.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_0}I was still once a Brettonian knight, if you need anything to be slain, I am your warrior.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_1}Hm, you wish to know of my life? It is a tale I can share.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_mousillon_1}I have always been surrounded by death, death is everything in the swamps of mousillon
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_mousillon_1}My fate was never to join the undead roaming the land, but to control them. To raise them and bend them to my will.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_mousillon_1}It has taken time but the dead do my bidding and my powers are ever growing.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_mousillon_1}I couldn't really care less about your wretched origin.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_1}I am a master of death and undeath, many fear me. Do you?
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}Greetings, noble sir. Do you need anything from this humble apothecary?
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}I have no history, young man. I was born and raised in the swampy forests of Mousillon, living off whatever the rivers and forests could provide me.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}Occasionally, a young village girl would come to my hut seeking help with someone sick or injured, and I would offer her my knowledge in exchange for their goodwill. This allowed me to eat something other than tasteless mushrooms and salted fish.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}I also sell talismans that I make myself. Oh, if only you knew the healing power of talismans.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}Mmm… living in isolation in the dangerous Mousillon's swamps, creating protective talismans… I bet there's some magic behind it all.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}Keep the drama. I know what you're, and I'd like to use your knowledge.

{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}Not magic! It's ancient knowledge from bygone eras, ancestral wisdom passed down from our ancestors. Although someone without the aptitude would surely call magic anything they can't understand.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_2}Although for a price, anyone could benefit. Including you. Do we have a deal?
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}Another wretch who needs a favor. Am I wrong?

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}Questions are bad in this business. Anything other than what needs to be moved and how much money is involved is out of the question. The less both parties know, better. Ignorance is often bliss in these cases. You don't feel remorse, and if someone catch you, they can't get anything out of you.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}I don't care if you want to bring fresh fruit from the other side of the cordon, or if you want to get your mother out of here in a barrel.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}If you want something or someone to move undetected, I'm your man.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}Would you be interested in an even more lucrative business serving an army in war?
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}A smuggler might be useful to me.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}Mmm… These people have less and less money on them and I barely cover the margin.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_mousillon_3}If you promise me good profits on a regular basis and a down payment, I'm all yours.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}About me? There is not much to tell.

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}I have fought all my life against ruinous powers. I made my own bow with the wood of trees so old that they stood tall when Ariel was just a mortal. I killed my first ungor at the age of eleven, and my first chaos spawn at fourteen. Recently, I struck a troll between the eyes with an arrow from two hundred paces away.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}Beasts, monsters, humans, or even other elves, if necessary—any creature that threatens the forest shall feel the sting of my arrows.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}Behold, with each enemy slain, my people cut their forearms to remember each enemy defeated. There remains space for more deaths.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}It's always good that there are fewer of those disgusting creatures in this world.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}A boy killing beasts? I find it hard to believe.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}I am a Ghost Strider of the Toriour caste, an expert in the art of ambush. I shall deliver the justice of the Eonir.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_eonir_0}I would prefer not to leave my beloved forests, but for a reasonable fee, I might be persuaded to accompany you on your travels for a time.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_eonir_1}Insolent boy, you stand before a Guardian Mage of the Eonir.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_eonir_1}Surely you don't have the slightest idea about our arcane power and bloodline.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_eonir_1}My lineage descends from an ancient line of warriors, tracing its origins to the War of the Beard itself.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_eonir_1}Indeed, one of my ancestors stood as the right hand of the great Caledor II, fighting alongside him in the Battle of the Three Towers.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_eonir_1}A proud lineage.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_eonir_1}Many people claim to be descended from great heroes of the past.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_eonir_1}Hold a moment, stranger. My services do not come cheap — you'd best prove your worth.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}Ah, I do not believe we have met. Peace be upon you, stranger.
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}Have you not encountered someone like me before? It is not surprising for I am a Spellsinger of the Asrai.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}Unlike the majority of my people, I possess the rare ability to commune with the magical beings of the deep forest. I can merge their minds with mine and assure their cooperation.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}For most Elves, the talent I wield amounts to little more than a mere instinct. But in truly gifted ones like myself, it becomes a formidable power.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}Certainly a fearsome power.
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}Those are stories one scares children with.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}The forest is a living entity. With proper respect, it can be persuaded to follow your command. Many seek out those with my abilities.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_woodelf_0}Many desire the presence of a Spellsinger, but few are prepared to pay the price.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}I do not recall seeing you here before. Who might you be?

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}I am the youngest daughter of a humble family that served a distinguished Asrai lord. However, lineage is not everything to us. For years, I have honed my skills with spear, sword, and bow. My bravery and leadership have earned me the title of Glade Captain.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}Yet, I still aspire to reach greater heights. To become a Glade Lady and earn the title of 'Talon of Kurnous,' I must build a formidable reputation and demonstrate my prowess to all of Athel Loren.

{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}The forest is a living entity. With proper respect, it can be shaped to your will. Many seek out those with my abilities. That is why I have ventured far from home, seeking new challenges to perfect my skills and earn a name that commands respect among the great houses of the Asrai.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}If you join in my company, I guarantee that you will have that opportunity
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}An Asrai's duty is in the forest, you should return home.
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}If your warband could need a second leader in command I am willing to join. I will lead your troops to victory
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_woodelf_1}Are you a renowned commander? Can you aid me in achieving such a status? I trust you have no objection to proving your worth.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}May Kurnous be with you, Stranger.

{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}I am a Waywatcher, a master of ambush and stealth. As a child, I felt the call of the forest coursing through my blood. I was trained to vanish into the wilds, unseen and undetectable, as I awaited my prey.

{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}I have ventured deep into the forest, where even the Asrai are not safe. While others remain sheltered in their halls, I have honed my skills and sharpened my aim.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}Few among the elves can hope to rival a Waywatcher like me with the bow.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}Certainly, you must be a prodigy
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}Didn't the Asrai enjoy your company?

{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}I am adept in the arts of survival, disruption, and ambush. I can approach my quarry, strike swiftly, and vanish before its body hits the ground. Alternatively, I can subtly lead it into one of my traps.

{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_woodelf_2}I have but one request. Although I seldom leave the forest, when I do, I seek the pleasures of civilised life. A fine wine in the tavern, pleasant company… I trust your group can provide these comforts.
{=str_tor_prebackstory_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}Do you hear them too? Those voices…
{=str_tor_backstory_a_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}Inside my head, those voices whisper to me, revealing to me the secrets of this world.
{=str_tor_backstory_b_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}Before there was confusion, now I see everything clearly. My purpose has been revealed to me.
{=str_tor_backstory_c_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}I must fulfill their will. I must open their eyes. There is no order without chaos, chaos itself is a purpose. The voices tell me that I have been chosen.
{=str_tor_response_1_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}Does that purpose involve wielding your sword?
{=str_tor_response_2_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}Where are the witch hunters when we need them?
{=str_tor_backstory_d_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}Chaos guides me, Chaos teaches me. I will shed the blood of non-believers if they refuse to see the truth.
{=str_tor_generic_backstory_tor_wanderer_chaos_0}You believe too, I know. That is why Chaos has brought you here. Are you committed to the cause?

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_sigmar}The Cult of Sigmar, also sometimes called the Church of Sigmar, the Holy Temple of Sigmar, the Clergy of Sigmar or simply the Sigmarite Cult, is the state church of the Empire that administrates the worship of that realm's patron god, Sigmar Heldenhammer. The Cult of Sigmar was founded by the wild-eyed friar Johann Helstrum in the year 73 IC, when he appeared before the masses to relate a vision that he experienced of Sigmar kneeling before Ulric, the god of war and winter, who placed the crown of godhood upon his brow as Sigmar took his place amongst the deities of the Old World Pantheon. As of today, the Cult of Sigmar has become an essential part of Imperial society. Nearly every city, town or village within the Empire has dedicated a portion of their wealth and land to the creation and maintenance of a Sigmarite temple, from which a priest of the Cult of Sigmar will attend to the spiritual well-being of its citizenry, whether it be through holy words of prayer or through heroic actions and trials by combat.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_taal}The Cult of Taal and Rhya is among the most ancient and pervasive in the Old World, tracing a direct line to the primal gods from the deepest of history. The cult grew organically, as early Humans tried to explain natural phenomenon, such as thunder, the turning of the seasons, and the rise and ebb of the seas. Over time, the Gods Taal and Rhya came into being, beginning as a single entity, known as Ishnernos. This split occurred many thousands of years ago, and the Cult of Ishnernos faded into distant memory. Taal rules nature and is considered King of the Gods. He claims the wild places as his domain and is primarily worshipped by hardy woodsmen, trackers, and rangers. Rhya's worshippers are found in the cultivated fields and orchards of the Empire, as well as among farmers, fishermen, and young lovers everywhere. The Cult of Taal and Rhya is the sanctioned cult of Talabecland, and is wildly popular in the eastern and northern parts of the Empire. Of the two, Taal receives most recognition, and Rhya's role is much diminished. The grand city of Talabheim is particularly fervent in its worship of both Taal and Rhya. However, in other cities, although Rhya's name is commonly known, her worship is rare, leading many urbanites to conclude that her cult is on the decline.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_shallya}The Cult of Shallya is dedicated to the White Dove of Mercy, the Lady in White, Shallya. Compassion, mercy and healing are the doctrines of the cult, and her priests offer aid to those in need across the Empire. The Old World is a gruelling place filled with disease, injury and bad fortune that can drive a person to utter despair, it is these folk who turn to Shallya whose priests bring the promise of mercy and comfort. Her temples double as hospitals for those who cannot afford a physician, run by her devout priestesses for few men serve her order.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_myrmidia}Myrmidia is the goddess of war and wisdom – One that is most popular in the southern realms of the Old World, such as Tilea and Estalia. Her providence inspires commanders with their unparalleled strategies and tactics, as well as soldiers, whose feints, blocks, and thrusts in combat almost seem like graceful and lethal choreography. Any combatant who fights with honour and for a just cause or one that seeks tactical knowledge will be favored by Myrmidia. Many would consider the Cult of Myrmidia to be the most organised religion in the Old World; the truth, however, is more complicated. There is a great deal of internal strife and contradictions within the Cult if one visits the great temple in Tilea and the Archecclesiastium in Estalia, each holding to their own beliefs, such as the legitimacy of Bellona Myrmidia and the Bellum Strategia. Tilean legends say that there was once a man called Tylos who made a pact with a goddess of wisdom and beauty and founded a great city with her help. However, Tylos wished his city to rival that of the elves, and in his hubris the city was doomed. Years later, when the elves left the Old World behind and humans slowly colonised the ruins, they found a newborn child in the ruins of what is now Remas. Her foster parents died young, and she was sold to a local duke infamous for his cruelty. Unable to bear his abuse any longer, the girl took up a spear and killed the duke. From then on she led Tilea and Estalia to greatness, with the aim to uphold the virtues of honour. Yet Estalians believe Myrmida to be the daughter of Morr and Verena, that she stepped forth from the heavens in Magritta, descending onto the same ground upon which the Archecclesiastium is built. In the bowels of the temple, pilgrims and priests alike can pray to the sacred rock with an imprint of Myrmidia's footprint.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_lady}The Cult of the Lady of the Lake, or simply the Cult of the Lady, is a state-official religious cult that serves to follow and uphold the values set upon them by the Lady of the Lake, and to serve the interest of her and the Kingdom of Bretonnia. Since ancient times, the Bretonnians have worshipped the Lady of the Lake as their goddess and their primary deity, a figure of myth and legend who guides their Kings and protects their lands from harm. Worship of the Lady can be traced to the earliest days of the Kingdom. It is said that she arose from a Sacred Lake before Gilles le Breton and his Knightly Companions on the dawn of the Great Victory of Bordeleaux. Wreathed in a fey light, the Lady rose from the water bearing a Grail which overflowed with light that spilled into the waters of the lake, blessing the assembled knights until dawn's light broke over the mountains.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_nagash}Vampires of all kinds loathe the gods. They don't deny their existence, but they don't serve them, seeking to be their equal instead. The closest idea of a religion to vampires would be their shared recognition of Nagash as the creator of undeath. Ultimately, all vampires descend from him. Nagash, known by many names such as the 'Great Necromancer', the 'Great Betrayer', the 'Usurper', the 'Undying King', the 'Supreme Lord of Undeath' or simply 'He Who Shall Not Be Named' is the ultimate personification of death and the Undead, an ancient, evil being who sought to conquer this cruel, chaotic mortal world and bring about an age of Undeath that will rule for all eternity. Nagash is darkness and unreasoning hatred given form, the father and creator of the foul art of necromancy and lord of all Vampires. His every action and deed is self-serving, his achievement horrific and loathsome, and his every whim bent solely to ensure that no one shall ever deny nor challenge his right to rule ever again.

{=str_tor_religion_description_chaos_undivided}The term Chaos Undivided refers to a faction among the forces of Chaos that serves the pantheon of the major Chaos Gods as a whole rather than owing complete fealty to one over the others. It is often represented by the Everchosen of Chaos, the mortal Chaos Lord who is the greatest champion of all the major Chaos Gods. Followers of Chaos Undivided venerate the force of Chaos itself, sometimes as an entity that some insane scholars of the Old World name the 'Great Beast' in which the major Chaos Gods are seen as a single deity whose four major constituent parts are to be worshipped equally as different emanations of the same universal force. At times, this entity sets aside its mad internal struggle, which is otherwise known as the Great Game, to make it possible for the fragmented armies of the major Chaos Gods to gather together under one banner, such as during the various Chaos incursions into the Known World like the Great War Against Chaos and the End Times. These moments cause the Old World to tremble and quake in fear and loathing.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_slaanesh}Slaanesh, also known as the 'Dark Prince', the 'Prince of Pleasure', the 'Lord of Excess', the 'God of Obsession', 'the Serpent', the 'Master of Excess in All Things', the 'Perfect Prince' and even the 'Prince of Chaos' is the major Chaos God of pleasure, passion, obsession, excess, hedonism, decadence and pain. Born of mortal inspiration and desire, Slaanesh is the great muse, the fulfiller of dreams. He is passion given form. He is pleasure incarnate, from the intellectual satisfaction of a problem solved to the fulfilment of baser desires. His is the domain of frustration and agony, the struggle to achieve that which mortals covet. He is titillation. He is suffering. He is the sum of all mortal experience.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_nurgle}Nurgle, also known as the 'Plague Lord', 'Grandfather Nurgle', the 'Lord of Pestilence', the 'Fly Lord', the 'Urfather' and 'the Crow' among many other names is the major Chaos God of disease, decay, despair, destruction, death and rebirth. Nurgle is the Chaos God most directly involved with the plight of mortals, particularly Men, who suffer so acutely from a fear of death. He is the eldest of the four Chaos Gods and indeed is undoubtedly the oldest Chaos God of all, for the process of death and decay is as ancient as life itself. Nurgle is the embodiment of the constant cycle of death and rebirth which animates all life in the universe, and was brought into being by mortals' fears of death and the despair they feel about their inevitable mortality from age and disease.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_khorne}Khorne, also known as the 'Blood God', the 'Lord of Murder', the 'Lord of Skulls', 'Hunter of Souls' and 'the Hound' in Norsca, is the major Chaos God of war, hatred, wrath, rage, murder, blood, strength, courage and martial honour. Khorne is the second eldest of the major Ruinous Powers and his waxing strength in this time of constant conflict often renders him the mightiest of the Chaos Gods in his effect on the mortal world and in the Great Game between the gods. His domain encompasses the most basic and brutal of sentient emotions - hate, anger, rage, the desire for destruction and the joy of killing one's enemies. Every act of killing or murder in the mortal world feeds and empowers Khorne, the more senseless, vicious and bloodthirsty, the better.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_tzeentch}Tzeentch, also known as the 'Changer of Ways', the 'Lord of Change', the 'Architect of Fate', the 'Wind-lord', the 'Raven God', and the 'Great Conspirator' is the major Chaos God of change, evolution, ambition, intrigue, destiny, lies, trickery, sorcery, knowledge, and mutation. Though weary scholars of daemonology know this god by the name of Tzeentch, in truth, he exceeds all the other Ruinous Powers in his number of facets, names and aspects. For he is change, said to embody every mortal creature's recognition of, and desire, to change, to grow, to move, to seek more -- more knowledge, more wealth, more power. His face and form shifts and turns from eternity unto eternity.

{=str_tor_religion_description_cult_of_grimnir}It is said that in the age when the Ancestor Gods still walked the world, the Dwarfen god Grimnir ventured northwards clad in nothing but his famed red crest and bearing his mighty axe. There, he met his doom, cutting down countless daemons until he reached the collapsed warpgate, where he stood vigil to bar their passage into the south. Since that time, those who now bear the name of 'Slayer' have followed in Grimnir's footsteps, seeking out mighty foes and striving to meet their end in battle or die trying. Yet it was in the time of King Baragor, the first of the Slayer Kings, that the Slayer Cult took a steep rise. Karak Kadrin became a haven for these doomed warriors, a place where they could find food and rest before marching towards their doom once more. The Cult of Grimnir is open to all warriors, but only a Slayer can access sacred shrines in Karak Kadrin. These deadly berserkers are bound by an oath to find their death against worthy foes, while regular warriors must uphold the warrior's code set by the cult, which includes attacking when possible, defending when required, always aiding your brothers-in-arms, and slaying as many foes as possible.

{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_WarriorPriestRoot}The Warrior Priest unleashes Sigmar's wrath for 8 seconds, which empowers him and the surrounding allies with 20% stronger melee attacks. Every point in Faith increases the melee effect by 0.05% and the duration by 0.05 seconds. The ability recharges by taking 50% of damage of total health. Blocked damage counts as 10% of the damage taken.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_BookOfSigmarKeyStone}Ability can also be charged by applying damage.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SigmarsProclaimerKeystone}Doubles the aura size of Righteous Fury.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_RelentlessFanaticKeyStone}Righteous Fury scales with Leadership. Troops affected get unbreakable for the duration.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ProtectorOfTheWeakKeyStone}Righteous Fury scales with the highest melee weapon skill. Adds 20% physical resistance.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HolyPurgeKeyStone}All units affected by Righteous Fury receive a burning weapon buff.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ArchLectorKeyStone}Adds a healing buff to Righteous Fury that restores 3 Hitpoints per second.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_TwinTailedCometKeystone}Righteous Fury adds a damaging aura. Its radius increases slightly when raising relevant skills.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_BookOfSigmarPassive1}Increases Hitpoints by 25.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_BookOfSigmarPassive2}Increases morale for all troops by 10.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_BookOfSigmarPassive3}After battle, all wounded companions are healed for 20 Hitpoints.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_BookOfSigmarPassive4}Wounded troops in your party heal faster.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SigmarsProclaimerPassive1}10% extra holy melee damage.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SigmarsProclaimerPassive2}All Sigmarite troops wages are reduced by 20%
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SigmarsProclaimerPassive3}Sigmarite troops get 25% resistance to physical ranged attacks.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SigmarsProclaimerPassive4}When praying at a shrine of Sigmar, all characters restore 50 Hitpoints.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_RelentlessFanaticPassive1}Increases Hitpoints by 25.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_RelentlessFanaticPassive2}10% extra holy melee damage.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_RelentlessFanaticPassive3}Party movement speed is increased by 1.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_RelentlessFanaticPassive4}Prayers aren't affected by global cooldowns.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ProtectorOfTheWeakPassive1}Increases Hitpoints by 25.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ProtectorOfTheWeakPassive2}Increases melee physical resistance by 15%.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ProtectorOfTheWeakPassive3}Increases Magic resistance against spells by 25%.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ProtectorOfTheWeakPassive4}Hits below 15 damage do not stagger the player.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HolyPurgePassive1}10% extra holy melee damage.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HolyPurgePassive2}All battles against forces of Chaos and undead earn 20% more prestige.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HolyPurgePassive3}All troops deal 10% more melee damage to non-human enemies.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HolyPurgePassive4}All Sigmarite troops gain 10% extra Holy damage.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ArchLectorPassive1}Prayers are recharged on battle start.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ArchLectorPassive2}All neutral Empire troops now count as Sigmarite troops.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ArchLectorPassive3}Gain 15% Ward save.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ArchLectorPassive4}All Sigmarite troops gain 20% Ward save.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_TwinTailedCometPassive1}10% extra holy melee damage.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_TwinTailedCometPassive2}Increases Companion Limit by 5.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_TwinTailedCometPassive3}Extra 20% armor penetration of melee attacks.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_TwinTailedCometPassive4}Increases Hitpoints by 30.

{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_WitchHunterRoot}A single enemy is marked for 8 seconds and the first hit inflicted against the target increases the physical damage by 20%. After every hit there is a 50% chance the marker stays on the target. For every point in Gunpowder or crossbow, the chances increases by 0.1% additional targets are marked.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ToolsOfJudgementKeystone}The Marker stays 6 seconds longer on the target. Ability scales with the higehest One- or Two-Handed-skill.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HuntTheWickedKeystone}20% additional physical damage for marked enemies. Melee damage can charge ability
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SilverHammerKeystone}Increases holy damage by 20% to the marked target. Ability scales with Faith.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_NoRestAgainstEvilKeystone}Shield penetration for the duration of the ability. Enemy stays marked
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SwiftProcedureKeystone}Marked enemies movement and swing speed is decreased. Ability scales with athletics
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_GuiltyByAssociationKeystone}Companions and Retinues can trigger mark effects. Companions can charge ability
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_EndsJustifiesMeansKeystone}Marked enemies suffering from overkill damage propagate mark. Scales with Rougery
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ToolsOfJudgementPassive1}Increases Hitpoints by 25.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ToolsOfJudgementPassive2}5 extra ammo
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ToolsOfJudgementPassive3}Extra melee damage (10%).
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_ToolsOfJudgementPassive4}Every headshot kill gains you roguery, count twice for marked targets.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HuntTheWickedPassive1}Player healing rate increased by 3
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HuntTheWickedPassive2}Ranged Infantry wages are 15% reduced.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HuntTheWickedPassive3}Every equipped ranged weapon increases melee damage by 10%.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_HuntTheWickedPassive4}Increases the damage of all ranged troops by 10%.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SilverHammerPassive1}Exterminated Undead and Ruinous powers increase faith per fallen Unit.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SilverHammerPassive2}All units deal more damage against undead and chaos.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SilverHammerPassive3}Increases Hitpoints by 25.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_SilverHammerPassive4}Troops can be upgraded to Witch Hunter Retinues.
{=str_tor_careerchoice_description_NoRestAgainstEvilPassive1}Extra holy melee damage (20%).

{=str_tor_career_description_warriorpriest}In life, Sigmar stood for the unification of Mankind, the destruction of evil and defiance against corruption. You hold the path set for you in his example high in your mind. To be a Priest of His faith is to be a Shepard to all mankind. Many of the cloth remain in their temples and cathedrals but you know the truth; the cursed and the damned must be sought out and vanquished.

{=str_tor_career_description_warriorpriestulric}To be a Wolf Priest is to be one of Ulrics champions, powerful, zealous, and blessed by the feral god himself. The battleground is where the word of Ulric is spread, and it is through bloodshed that he is honoured in worship.

{=str_tor_career_description_bloodknight}Sired by Abhorash, the Blood Knight is a dark mockery of everything noble or virtuous that can be said about their mortal counterparts. Where before the Blood Kiss there was honour is now cruelty; faith turns to irreverence and duty falls to wanton ambition. This is true of all vampires but seems particularly tragic for the fallen knights of the Old World.

{=str_tor_career_description_MinorVampire}Known and feared by many names, Vampires are the night's dark master. Nighly anyone be they Man or Beast, Holy or Daemonic can face one and survive. All Vampires strive to be the only masters of their unlife, free from any obligations to religions or masters. This egomaniacal drive is what fuels them to greater and greater ambitions, so that one day they may be lord of all they observe.

{=str_tor_career_description_mercenary}To be a Man in the 25th century is to be one of thousands. The Old World finds itself on the precipice of destruction and turmoil, of chaos and death. No one in this age can be weak; some use the times to their advantage and turn warfare into wealth, combat into glory and tragedy into destiny. Mercenary they may call you, whatever the name no one will control your fate.

{=str_tor_career_description_grailknight}To be a knight of Bretonnia is to strive for the blessing of the Lady and her holy grail. Any man deemed worthy to sup from her chalice becomes a holy warrior honored and respected across all of Bretonnia and yet farther. The road to that goal is difficult, so much so that most knights fail to accomplish despite all sharing the same dream.

{=str_tor_career_description_graildamsel}Damsels are sought out as children by the Fey Enchantress for their latent magical potential. Taken away from their families they are raised in secret to be potent guardians of fair Bretonnia. Upon completion of their training they embark out into the land, coming to the aid of the people and influencing knights in order to fulfill their martial potential.

{=str_tor_career_description_necromancer}While many of these dark magisters serve under immortal vampires, it is actually the study of death and undeath that predates the vampire. Necromancers dedicate their lives researching the ultimate question facing every mortal; how to live forever? To the philosophically virtuous necromancer, vampirism is but one of the more successful failures at answering this question. The true answer is believed by these fell scholars to lay in study and innovation of the work of Nagash, the first and greatest necromancer of all time.

{=str_tor_career_description_witchhunter}Whether in the name of faith, purity or reward, Witch Hunters are charged with ending the threat created by all those who spread the taint of darkness. They justify their weapons, unconventional instruments and methods of investigations in the name of protecting innocent souls. A mostly thankless task, as even those who they are sworn to protect fear the shadow of a Witch Hunter at their threshold.

{=str_tor_career_description_blackgrailknight}Foreboding and Dreadful, Knights of the Black Grail are the personal retinue of the mysterious Serpent of Mousillon. As strong as they are cunning, Knights of the Black Grail have a knack for strategy and show great aptitude when faced with the many politics of Bretonnia. Even so, their honeyed words and forked tongue often reach into the hearts of many, drawing more to their cause of "freeing" Bretonnia from the filthy lie of the Lady.

{=str_tor_career_description_necrarch}Amongst all the creations of Nagash, the Necrarchs are perhaps the closest in image to their dark lord. All Necrarchs are dedicated towards one single goal, furthering their necromantic power; hiding away from civilisation they endlessly study and practice their foul magic. On the few occasions one has left their self-imposed isolation, it is almost always followed by a trail of carnage and ruin as few can survive these eternal fiends.

{=str_tor_career_description_imperialmagister}Magisters of the Colleges of Magic lead a prestigious life as they are given space and resources to hone their skills in safety – all this in exchange for a life of service to their Order and the Empire as a whole. The duties of a Magister are vast and may range from the destruction of dark forces to advising the lords and ladies of the Empire in various matters. While ordinary men of the Empire may scoff at the necessity of Magisters, the wise know them to be wardens against Chaos and its sorcery.

{=str_tor_career_description_waywatcher}Waywatchers serve as the ultimate watchmen of Athel Loren, lords over the many paths leading in and out of the ancient wood. Master woodsmen and hunters, they can lie in ambush for several days, fire unerringly accurate barrages of arrows, and lay terrifying traps designed to kill, maim and dishearten any trespasser. Few marksmen can even approach a Waywatcher’s ability with the bow, even among the elves, as these elves have drifted the furthest away from elven civilization, embracing fully the call of the living forest.

{=str_tor_career_description_greylord}The Greylords were once powerful mages of Ulthuan, but they were exiled for their cruel experiments. Today, the Greylords continue their often-dangerous experiments in secret in Laurelorn, willingly teach their apprentices the forbidden magic. The Greylords are not to be trifled with, by their power alone has the forest of Laurelorn been saved many times, though some remain fearful their powers may also doom the Eonir.

{=str_tor_career_description_spellsinger}Spellsingers have a unique bond with Athel Loren, they are bound to the forest through magical ritual, giving then the same communal awareness that dryads or treekin enjoy, without sacrificing their individuality. While the lesser Spellsingers commune with the forest, the greater ones can reshape it for building of homes or destruction of enemies. In Athel Loren Spellsingers are artists and mages, and invariably are the ones that travel outside the forest to engage in rare diplomacy. While both men and women become Spellsingers, the women typically become stronger due to Ariel's bond with the forest of Athel Loren.

{=str_tor_career_description_knightoldworld}The Old World is a home to numerous Knightly Orders. Their members ordinarily follow one particular deity, like the ferocious White Wolves of Ulric or the accomplished Blazing Suns of Myrmidia. But it's not uncommon to encounter secular Orders like the Knights Panther. While rather varied in terms of equipment, faiths, or beliefs, such knights ultimately share similar goals: promotion of their Orders and annihilation of all things foul. Knights of the Old World are also famous for their elite training, finest gear, as well as influence that extends across the four corners of the realm.

{=str_tor_career_description_ironbreaker}Fighting in the narrow underground tunnels is a really tough and tedious experience. Equipped with the best gromril armor that the clan can provide and with an impenetrable shield wall formation, they are responsible for protecting the most vulnerable accesses of the karaks to the last breath. Serving as an Iron Breaker is considered a great honor, as only the strongest and bravest among the dwarves are admitted.

{=str_tor_career_description_slayer}Dwarves are a proud race. Failure is an affront to their honor and a scar that is almost indelible. Dwarves whose honor has been tarnished become Slayers; they will abandon their family, their possessions, and even their clan to pursue a path of redemption. And there is only one way to redeem their honor: death in the battlefield. In times of war, slayers will abandon their self-imposed exile to put their martial skills to the service of the dwarven cause; where they will meet their final destiny.

{=str_tor_career_description_warden}All Elves comes to the defence of Athel Loren in times of need. Trained not only with bow, but also with spear, sword, mounted combat and in some cases magic, the Lords of the Glade herald in the might of the Wood Elves and the Spirits of Athel Loren. Leading the charge and conceiving battle plans like no other, these Lords and Ladies are great warriors on and off the field, out maneuvering and flanking with deadly strength.

{=str_tor_career_description_runelord}The Dwarfs are masters of craft, their forge-fires burning with the memory of ages past. Among their greatest artisans stand the Runesmiths, proud descendants of Thungni, the Ancestor God of Runelore. Gifted with the sacred knowledge of Runecraft, they bind power into steel with secret glyphs passed down since the Time of Woes.{newline}{newline}Sworn to secrecy and perfection, a Runesmith's every blow upon the anvil echoes with meaning. Their armor is warded, their weapons etched with runes that can break sorcery or strengthen allies. Runesmiths are both warriors and artisans, unflinching defenders of Dwarfen tradition and honour.

{=str_tor_career_description_OrcBoss}Da Boss iz da meanest, greenest, an' best git. Da biggest 'un in any mob! To be proppa tuff an' ded 'ard kill- Oi! You dere! Woz you givin' me da stink eye!? HUH!!?? You want sum of dis an' dat!? Yeah, you betta run, ya git. Anywayz, I wuz sayin'… Errr… Dat's right, wez' gunna 'ead out, boyz. Snap da necks o' humies, stunties, an' any uvva filthy gits in da way. Stikk 'em an' make 'em squeal. We iz strong, an' da strong 'uns always win. Everyfing dere is will be mine, an' we go 'til der is nuffin' left! Iz time to WAAAAAGH!!!

{=str_tor_career_description_OrcShaman}You sees, da Boss iz da meanest, baddest, greenest, an' best git. Da biggest 'un in any mob, wiv da biggest choppas an' blockas eva'! To be proppa tuff an' ded 'ard kill- Oi! You dere! Woz you givin' me da stink eye!? HUH!!?? You want sum of dis an' dat!? Yeah, dat's right, you betta run, ya git. Anywayz, I wuz sayin'… Errr… Dat's right, wez' gunna 'ead out, boyz. Snap da necks of humies, stunties, an' any uvva filthy gits in our way. Teach 'em a lesson. Stikk 'em an' make 'em squeal. We iz strong, an' da strong 'uns always win. Move it, ladz! Everyfing dere is will be mine, an' we go until der is nuffin' left! Iz time to WAAAAAGH!!!

{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_prestige}Is used for upgrading special units of the Empire and special actions. - very drab description, consider the one for Dark Energy which blends both a narrative use with mechanical ones. Eonir favor is a good one as well; it contextualizes the resource's use as being part of the society - it's an intangible thing that has taken a specific form for a game mechanic, but it situates the player within the narrative of the society in lore.
{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_chivalry}Is used for upgrading special units of Bretonnia and special actions.
{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_darkenergy}Dark Energy is used by practitioners of necromancy to raise and upkeep their undead minions.

{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_forestharmony}Forest Binding is used to upgrade and maintain troops of the woodelves, as well as retrieve upgrades at the Oak of Ages. - binding looks like it was an old term that was used temporarily and was never changed

{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_councilfavor}Retrieve power in the Eonir council and use it to your benefit. - retrieve is not the right word, perhaps curry, gain, accumulate, consolidate, find(nyeh), build, etc…
{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_oathgold}Spend Oathgold to unlock various perks and support Dwarfen guilds.
{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_teef}In Greenskin societies, Teef are proof of dominance, as well as the main currency of their tribes.
{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_meat}Just a helper resource nothing to see here
{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_waaagh}Fightiness increases through smashing enemies and decreases during periods of inactivity or suffering defeats. Greenskins thrive on constant warfare.
{=str_tor_custom_resource_description_windsofmagic}Winds of Magic is used by spellcasters to cast spells.

{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_start1}A haunting aura hangs over the desolate battlefield before you, where the Empire's valor clashed with the dark might of the Vampire Counts. You encounter a battlefield, where the ground is littered with the remnants of war – broken blades, shattered shields, and the fallen bodies of both soldiers and undead horrors. A hush pervades the air, punctuated only by the distant cries of carrion birds. You can faintly feel the weight of necromantic magic tainting the winds.

{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_start2}The fallen lie in solemn repose, their lives and fates forever intertwined in the tragedy of this place. As you step onto the blood-soaked earth, the weight of history and sacrifice bears down upon you.
{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_start3}What course of action will you choose amid this poignant scene?

{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_searchforsurvivors1}With a blend of hope and trepidation, you navigate the grim tableau of fallen soldiers, searching for any spark of life amidst the sea of death. Your determination leads you to a wounded soldier, his breathing labored and weak. Kneeling beside him, you offer aid and solace, tending to his injuries as best you can.
{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_searchforsurvivors2}His eyes flutter open, and gratitude glimmers within them. In hushed tones, he expresses his thanks, vowing to repay your kindness.

{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_useghyranmagic1}Harnessing the magic of Ghyran, your wizard calls upon the life-giving energies of nature itself. The air shimmers with verdant energy as the wizard channels the spell, guiding it toward the wounded soldier. The soldier's injuries begin to mend, his breathing steadying and color returning to his cheeks.
{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_useghyranmagic2}With a weak but grateful smile, the survivor acknowledges your miraculous intervention. He expresses his heartfelt thanks and vows to join you ranks.

{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_helpbutdie1}Despite your best efforts, the soldier's condition deteriorates rapidly. His labored breaths grow shallower, and his gaze loses focus. Despite your valiant attempts, the soldier's life slips away, leaving behind an aura of melancholy and an unshakable sense of futility.
{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_helpbutdie2}With a heavy heart, you bow your head in reverence, honoring the fallen soldier's valiant struggle.

{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_payrespects1}Bowing your head in solemn reverence, you offer your respects to the fallen soldiers who laid down their lives on this haunted battlefield. A sense of camaraderie and shared purpose settles over your party, a poignant reminder of the enduring struggle between Morr and undeath.
{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_payrespects2}With your silent tribute complete, you gather your resolve, determined to vanquish the looming darkness that threatens the realm.
{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_continueon1}You choose to leave the battlefield behind and continue on your journey.

{=str_tor_inky_battlefield_str_continueon2}As you walk away, the landscape seems to exhale a mournful sigh, forever bearing witness to the trials of those who dared to stand against the tides of darkness.

{=str_tor_inky_duel_str_start3notmetbefore}"Ah, what a stroke of luck to meet a band of worthy warriors on this lonely path," they say. And now, fate has led me to you. Care to prove your skills in a friendly duel, with a little wager to make it exciting?"

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_lowclanlevel}I do not do business with nobodies, stranger, and I do not know you. Now begone. (Low Renown).

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_nobleintroduction1}It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, I am {SHORTTITLE}{FIRSTNAME} {LASTNAME}{TITLE}. You have been making quite a name for yourself it would seem, many amongst the Imperial courts know of your exploits.

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_nobleintroduction2}I make it my business to know important, and useful, people. Connections are my trade you see, I do believe a relationship between us could prove to be very lucrative.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_nobleintroduction3}I can help you further your power and influence within the courts of the Empire and all I ask in return is that you return the favour when needed.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_hubintro}There are a number of projects that could be of interest to you. What should we consider?
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_hubintrorepeat}Is there something else what I can do for you?
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_itemsask_p}Are there any items of interest you might have for me?

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_itemsintro}Hmm.. currently there is only one thing I have on hand, but it is very unique. A beast from the Imperial Menagerie, should you be interested? - If he only has one thing on hand, why are you prompted to select among demigryphs?
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_mountinquiry_p}What sort of beast?
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_nointerestitems_p}Maybe something different.(back)

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_demigryphexplain}Due to some rather unfortunate circumstances, we have a monstrous steed without a rider. A Demigryph, to be precise. While the rider will be missed, the keeper of the Imperial Menagerie doesn't know what to do with it. Luckily, I have contacts within the Order of the fallen Knight and they may be willing to entrust the mount to you… ({DEMIGRYPH_COST}{PRESTIGE_ICON})
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_demigryphbuy_p}Price is no issue, such a mighty steed would be worth it. ({DEMIGRYPH_COST}{PRESTIGE_ICON})
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_demigryphinquirytitle}Choose your demigryph!

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_demigryphinquirydescription}The Noble offers you his service, one of his demigryphens(ons?) he kept in the menagerie is available to you. - itemsIntro should concord with this
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_demigryphrefuse_p}Not at this time, perhaps later.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingask_p}I would like to invest in infrastructure, what are my options?

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingprojecthub}An interesting choice, there are a number of projects slated for the future… but with the right amount of coin I can ensure you are known as the magnimonous benefactor behind their expedited construction.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingoption0}[Dedicate a statue to Sigmar Heldenhammer]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingoption1}[Help fund the construction of a Temple of Shallya]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingoption2}[Construct a new dry dock]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingoption3}[Imperial Training Grounds]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingoption4}[Renovate the Heldenhammer]

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingexplain0}The Cult of Sigmar within Altdorf has ambitions to build a rather sizeable statue of our most glorious Sigmar upon a hill with a prestigous view of his beloved Empire. They are lacking in some funding to ensure it's timely completion, I can ensure your name is written upon such a wondrous memorial for a measly cost. ({BUILDING_COST} {GOLD_ICON}) - this can be formatted differently to read as something like 400K (gold icon) rather than 400000 (icon)

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingexplain1}There are many who suffer across the Empire and Shallya's priestesses are needed more than ever, however funding a Temple to the Lady in White is no small endeavour. You can be sure that, for a little coin, your name will be praised for generations for aiding in such a selfless act. ({BUILDING_COST} {GOLD_ICON})

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingexplain2}The threat we face from Norsca is ever present, the Elector Count of Nordland has called for the construction of a new dry dock to empower the Imperial Navy. It has already been funded by the local lords… however for a little extra I can ensure you are known as the prime contributor. ({BUILDING_COST} {GOLD_ICON})

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingexplain3}The forests and the hills of the Empire need constant patrols to ensure the safety of it's citizens, one of the local garrisons is in dire need of training equipment and you have an opportunity to provide it for them. ({BUILDING_COST} {GOLD_ICON})

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingexplain4}It takes a lot of coin to keep the mighty Heldenhammer afloat, the Grand Theogonist and the Cult of Sigmar will look very favourably upon any who donate to ensure it is battle ready at all times. ({BUILDING_COST} {GOLD_ICON})

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingpay_p}That sounds good, I will send you the funding. ({BUILDING_COST} {GOLD_ICON}) This can be reformated to seem less awkward with restating the cost - the player should see the npc's previous description on the left with this confirmation option on the right.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_buildingrefuse_p}Not at this time, perhaps later.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_nointerestbuildings_p}Maybe something different.(back)
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceask_p}I have an interest in the many organisations of the Empire, are there any who I could aid?

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceprojecthub}Many parties and organisations throught the empire need your support. Are you willing to provide them the power they need? - power is awkward here, the player is providing political support. They are swaying attention towards the various possibilities so that additional resources are diverted to them - power isn't an object to give.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceoption0}[Find support for a diplomatic mission to Ulthuan to establish a new trade route.]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceoption1}[Support the Traders Guild envoy on a mission to establish gunpowder trade with Cathay]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceoption2}[[Support the Engineers Guild technological innovation.]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceoption3}[Help fund a Huntsmen Expedition to Lustria]
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceoptionrepeatable}[Enlarge your Influence throughout the Empire (Repeatable)] - this option disappears from the list if the player has under 25 influence

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceexplain0}A diplomatic mission is set to leave for Ulthuan, but they fear they are lacking in gifts elegent enough to appease the knife ears… elves. Perhaps you could help them? ({INFLUENCE_COST} {INFLUENCE_ICON})

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceexplain1}It is with faith, steel and gunpowder that we protect the Empire and we need a lot of gunpowder. Cathay also also makes use of black powder and in a hope to bring our two peoples closer, the Trade Guild has sent an envoy to establish trade ties. Some Elector Counts are not convinced yet. ({INFLUENCE_COST} {INFLUENCE_ICON})

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceexplain2}The wonders of the Engineers Guild are many but they are equally as costly to invent, test and so forth. Funding their experimental endeavours would earn you an ample amount of public opinion. ({INFLUENCE_COST} {INFLUENCE_ICON})

{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influenceexplain3}Beasts are myriad within the jungles of Lustria, the Huntsmen are set to go on a hunt soon but could use help acquiring provisions for such an arduous journey. ({INFLUENCE_COST} {INFLUENCE_ICON})
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influencepay_p}This sounds good, I will support this. ({INFLUENCE_COST} {INFLUENCE_ICON})
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_influencerefuse_p}Not at this time, perhaps later.
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_nointerestinfluence_p}Maybe something different.(back)
{=str_tor_empire_prestigenoble_exitconvo_p}Thanks, I will come back to you.

{=str_tor_bloodkiss_request}My lord von Carstein, I wish to shed my mortal shell and serve you eternally.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_answer_line2}Thou hast served me and mine loyally, I shall grant thee the Blood kiss if thou so desireth.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_answer_line3}However, this gift does not come without cost, to be granted the blood kiss thou canst never go back. Art thou sure?
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_player_ready}I am ready my lord.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_player_dontbotherme}Then think about it someplace else, thou disturbeth mine plans.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_receive}Prepare thine self for thine dark awakening.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_player_receive_end}Rise, von Carstein scion.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_request_blooddragon}Grandmaster, I wish to join your ranks of the Blood dragons as a Blood Knight.

{=str_tor_bloodkiss_blooddragon_answer_line2}Ah, indeed, a Warrior of incredible prowess stands before me, daring to seek the Blood Kiss from none other than Walach Harkon. While you are besmirched by your mortality, your valor and devotion to the ideals of knighthood are truly commendable, and I find myself intrigued by your unwavering pursuit of perfection.

{=str_tor_bloodkiss_blooddragon_answer_line3}To be worthy of the Blood Kiss is no small feat, and yet, I sense in you a rare dedication to the principles that guide the Order of the Blood Dragons. Your thirst for excellence and your unwavering discipline resonate strongly. The vows you have sworn, the code of chivalry you uphold – they mirror the very foundations upon which the Blood Dragons stand.

{=str_tor_bloodkiss_blooddragon_answer_ready}Know this, knight, the Blood Kiss is not a gift to be granted lightly. It is an eternal bond, a oath of fealty to kindred and I. All pathetic mortal senses of mercy and weakness will be purged from you (MAGIC ABILITIES WILL BE REMOVED!). Your desires for power and dominance shall be sated forevermore.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_blooddragon_player_ready}I am ready, Grandmaster.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_blooddragon_receive}Embrace the Bloodkiss, become one with the night, and ascend to greatness alongside the Blood Dragons.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_blooddragon_player_receive_end}Rise, young blood dragon.
{=str_tor_bloodkiss_necrach_request}My lord. Zacharias. The Everliving. The disciple of Melkihor the Ancient. The most powerful of necrarchs. I wish to shed my mortal shell and serve you eternally. -
{=str_tor_blackgrail_request}You keep saying the Lady is not real. What exactly do you mean?
{=str_tor_blackgrail_answer_line1}Not every Bretonne is ready for the truth. Are you willing to cleanse yourself from the Lie that we Bretonnes dogmatically follow?
{=str_tor_blackgrail_answer_line2}I can tell you once you take the path I am wandering on, there is no salvation, and before we open the eyes of all Bretonnes, you will be an enemy of the King.
{=str_tor_blackgrail_answer_ready}So I ask you again, are you really willing to to know the truth about the lady?
{=str_tor_blackgrail_answer_player_ready}I am ready, mylord.
{=str_tor_blackgrail_dontbotherme}Then think about it someplace else. We are done here.

{=str_tor_blackgrail_receive}The truth is: The Bretonnes, proud humans follow the whisperings of an Elf. The Lady is nothing more than a Elven Witch, not a goddess or saint. Our whole Kingdom is build upon the Lie of Lady. I will clean you from these lies, drink from this grail, and gain the true powers of Bretonnia!
{=str_tor_blackgrail_receive_end}Rise my young Knight. Let us clean this world from this non sense.
{=str_tor_spelltrainer_start}Do I know you? What do you need, be quick I am a busy.
{=str_tor_spelltrainer_open_book}I have come seeking further knowledge.
{=str_tor_spelltrainer_close_book}Hmm, come then. I will teach you what I can.
{=str_tor_spelltrainer_scrolls}Do you sell any scrolls?
